body: I'm not usually into the concept of a buffet... but the buffet showcased at Naseeb Indian Restaurant is great. I came here a few months ago with my sister and mum. We came in on a Friday afternoon and were greeted kindly. The buffet was steaming with fresh food. I enjoyed pretty much every dish that was showcased. The hot milk tea (chai) is a lovely way to end a nice lunch at Naseeb's. I liked how each dish had its own flavor and that the food wasn't overwhelmingly spicy. Naseeb is a great choice for those that are interested in trying out Indian food. There is plenty of variety and I would definitely suggest the buffet on the weekend.

title: Review: Nazif’s — 2013-04-06
summary: Having been to Turkiye recently, and having been influenced with many Turkish friends.. I would have to say Nazif's restaurant cooks up some pretty authentic food. I recently came here on a weekend afternoon and to my surprise it wasn't too busy. My family and I were greeted kindly, and were given p
body:
Having been to Turkiye recently, and having been influenced with many Turkish friends.. I would have to say Nazif's restaurant cooks up some pretty authentic food. I recently came here on a weekend afternoon and to my surprise it wasn't too busy. My family and I were greeted kindly, and were given prompt service. Our food came on time and all of our meals were delicious.
We ordered the kibbi (icli kofte) and it was nice, crunchy, and spicy. The lamacun (flat-bread with meat) was flavourful and vibrant when mixed with the pickled cabbage. The kimali pide (meat pie) was hearty with meat and studded with nuts and parsley on top. For dessert, we ordered the rice pudding, and it was cold, thick, and creamy. We ended our meal with some Turkish style tea. This sort of cuisine cant be ended without any tea. There lunch prices are a bit steep, but it's still a good deal when considering all you get. I can honestly say that all the dishes were made well and were quite filling. I'll probably even bring my picky Turkish friends sometime soon. I'm looking forward in trying out their other dishes as well. There are some specific dishes here that I haven't spotted in the other Turkish restaurants that are in town. Oh, and if you're planning on ordering the kunefe for dessert, I would suggest you do that ahead of time, since that dessert takes time in preparing. That is something im definitely looking forward in trying next time around.

title: Review: Nikoz Fusion Grill — 2013-06-11
summary: This place is a hit or miss. It doesn't really leave you with anything. Several of the items on the menu are not even available at the restaurant. I ordered the Beef Souvlaki, as well as the side salad and hummus. The pieces of meat were nicely grilled and simply flavoured. The beef is the only item
body:
This place is a hit or miss. It doesn't really leave you with anything. Several of the items on the menu are not even available at the restaurant.
I ordered the Beef Souvlaki, as well as the side salad and hummus. The pieces of meat were nicely grilled and simply flavoured. The beef is the only item on my plate that I liked. The salad was a decent Greek style salad that came with grocery style salad dressing. It didnt have a pleasant taste. The hummus was grainy and flavorless. I could tell that it was made with canned beans. After a not-so-great meal, I decided to wash it down with a cup of chai. Bad mistake. This was probably the worst chai I drank in my entire life. It was entirely watery, with an unequal ratio of canned milk and water. The teabag sitting in the drink was lifeless. The manager chuckles and doesn't seem to care about the quality of his food. I most likely wont be coming back here again. For the most part, everything is poorly executed here.

title: Review: Nom Mi Street — 2013-02-04
summary: Nom Mi Street is one of the most colorful and cutest food trucks that I have ever encountered! This is a fusion food truck that you can tickle your taste-buds with! I ordered the vegetarian banh mi that came with fried tofu, veggies, and cilantro. The sandwich was flavourful and toasty. I felt as if
body:
Nom Mi Street is one of the most colorful and cutest food trucks that I have ever encountered!
This is a fusion food truck that you can tickle your taste-buds with! I ordered the vegetarian banh mi that came with fried tofu, veggies, and cilantro. The sandwich was flavourful and toasty. I felt as if the tofu was too fried for my liking, but enjoyed it anyway since it was crispy. My friend ordered the fusion fries and enjoyed them. It came with some crispy meat and was garnished with cilantro. He is an avid lover of anything spicy, so he dolloped an extra amount of sriracha sauce on his fries.
It took some time for them to make my sandwich, but other than that, I was content with my order. At the time, I was attending UH, so I found it to be a healthier choice then ordering food at the fast food joints sprawled around campus. This truck offers some other unique eats that I havent tried yet, such as the quesadillas. You get to choose the meat and the toppings, and they make it fresh for you. It's a tantalizing experience worth savoring.

title: Review: Nordstrom Ebar Artisan Coffee — 2015-09-07

body: Always good coffee. My favorite little spot to grab a warm and comforting latte during a nice stroll in the Galleria. My favorite is the honey almond latte which isn't on the menu. The taste is fragrant, sweet, and full of flavor. Coffee is made right with a nice and smooth taste. No bitter notes. Their vanilla latte and mocha are nice as well. Ebar also has a nice variety of sweets as well to pair with your coffee. The chocolate chip cookies and a few of the other desserts are from SWEET. Their are many other snacks and bars to choose from as well. Overall, Ebar is a nice little spot to visit while in the area. The coffee is a good little pick me up to keep you focused on your shopping!

title: Review: Nothing Bundt Cakes — 2012-11-09
summary: I've actually never been inside Nothing Bundt Cakes, but I have tried a few of their delectable treats when there happened to be an occasion that I was invited to. I recently tried the red velvet bundt cake, and was pleasantly surprised as to how moist the cake was. Its usually hard to come across a
body:
I've actually never been inside Nothing Bundt Cakes, but I have tried a few of their delectable treats when there happened to be an occasion that I was invited to.
I recently tried the red velvet bundt cake, and was pleasantly surprised as to how moist the cake was. Its usually hard to come across a good red velvet cake that actually has a velvety texture. The cream cheese frosting that is typically on a red velvet cake was perfect. The frosting was not overly sweet, and it had a nice creamy texture. I could taste the tangy flavor of the cream cheese which wasn't masked by an overwhelming amount of sugar. I also liked how the red velvet cake was studded with big chocolate chips. This made the cake different from the typical red velvet cakes that I have tried.
I would love to checkout the actual store, as I believe they offer stationary sets and designer cupcake liners. I heard the store closes early everyday, so this place must be visited early in the afternoon; especially if you want to purchase a cake for an occasion, it must be done ahead of time.
I'm looking forward to trying out the other flavours this bakery has to offer. If only I can make the courage to get up early and make it in time before it closes!

title: Review: Old Saigon Cafe — 2017-12-31
summary: Dining here was magical. The food tasted amazing and it was a special night overall. Appreciated the warm service and hospitality. The menu displays a variety of items to nosh on. Found a unique item off the menu which was the artichoke appetizer. It normally isn't found in Vietnamese cafes.. but It
body: Dining here was magical. The food tasted amazing and it was a special night overall. Appreciated the warm service and hospitality. The menu displays a variety of items to nosh on. Found a unique item off the menu which was the artichoke appetizer. It normally isn't found in Vietnamese cafes.. but It was recommended to us by the owner, so we gave it a shot. The artichokes were presented nicely, all dressed up in lemon and olive oil. They were meaty, tender, and tasty. Lemony and refreshing on the palate. Tried the spicy chicken lemongrass banh mi. The bread was fresh and crispy. Shredded chicken was spicy, saucy and very flavorful. I enjoyed the spicy kick in this sandwich. It was quite different than any other banh mi I had tried. Banh mi was served in a basket and came with french fries as well. Warm, crispy fries paired with a spicy chicken sandwich? Not bad. The crab and mango soft rolls were unique as well. Stuffed with crab and sweet mango, these rolls were light and filling. Served with the usual nuoc cham (dipping sauce) and peanut dipping sauce. All three items were delightful.. I can see myself coming back just for those items.. Although I do want to try the tableside pho, especially with our current weather. Seems fitting. Old Saigon cafe is a clean and simple little place tucked on Westheimer road. There are quite a few restaurants in this strip. But, if you're looking for fresh, healthy and flavorful food.. you'll find it here.

I recommend this little spot - trust me, you will not regret a unique experience at Orange Nail Spa & Facial.

title: Review: Paciugo Gelato — 2010-05-29
summary: Nice selection. Pacuigo`s serves up authentic flavours of gelato! Summer`s calling, and I have a strong feeling I`ll be dropping by soon. I have tasted both the creamy gelato`s, and the sorbetti`s. They are all fresh tasting, and full of flavour. I love the display and the presentations of the sweet
body:
Nice selection. Pacuigo`s serves up authentic flavours of gelato!
Summer`s calling, and I have a strong feeling I`ll be dropping by soon.
I have tasted both the creamy gelato`s, and the sorbetti`s. They are all fresh tasting, and full of flavour. I love the display and the presentations of the sweet treats. There is no need to feel guilt after having a nice cup of gelato! You see.. unlike ice cream, gelato is made with low-fat milk. It has less sugar as well.
I always decide on the smallest cup. It may seem at first that you may not get much gelato, but the workers really know how to nicely stuff your cup with whatever flavours you choose. Try the panna cotta, chocolate sorbetti, or any of the berry flavours.
Your palette will be pleased with a creamy and refreshing treat!
During winter, I would suggest trying out the 'affogato al espresso'. It`s basically an espresso float! You choose the gelato flavour, and it gets dunked nicely into your coffee. It is also served with a small biscotti on the side.
Mm, what can I say. Buonisimo! ;)

body: Paciugo has a large selection of gelato and coffee beverages. At the time I visited, they had many holiday beverages. But.. The gelato here is strikingly sweet.. I had a difficult time in finishing the small cup of gelato I ordered. The flavour was there, but the sweetness was just too much for me and my family. I used to frequent Paciugo many years back when they were in Sugar Land. I feel as if the flavour was better at that location. Too bad they closed down. But on the bright side, their are a few other places in Houston that make a light tasting gelato without dumping in too much sugar to please the American palate. If this is your type of place.. then go ahead and indulge. The caffe was quite busy when I visited at night and the plaza is a popular spot among families and young people. The servers were friendly and I appreciated their service but I wont be frequenting anytime soon.

title: Review: Pangea Bar & Grill — 2018-01-23
summary: I recently visited Pangea with my sister and a good friend of ours. We came here on the night of New Years Eve. The outside of the restaurant was vividly glowing at night. The inside was lit up as well. It was spacious and very decorative. I like the style of this place. Makes me feel like i'm sitti
body:
I recently visited Pangea with my sister and a good friend of ours. We came here on the night of New Years Eve. The outside of the restaurant was vividly glowing at night. The inside was lit up as well. It was spacious and very decorative. I like the style of this place. Makes me feel like i'm sitting inside a Sultan's palace. The inside of Pangea is huge. Plenty of indoor seating as well as outdoor seating which is towards the back. The outdoor seating is ideal for those who are into hookah. I'm not fond of that stuff, so i'm glad the inside of the place wasn't reeking of hookah stench. Pangea is not like the dingy hookah cafes we have in Houston which are overcrowded and obnoxious. Its an actual family style restaurant with a good feel to it. We sat ourselves upon a comfortable couch towards the front with a large coffee table. Throughout the night we received warm and attentive service. The manager and waiters were very friendly and made us feel welcomed.
In terms of the food: I recommend trying the Pangea sampler: it consists of 4 of each item: grape leaves, falafel, kibbe, and empanadas. The food was freshly prepared as it took some time and it came out hot and crisp. Absolutely enjoyed each item off the sampler and paired quite well with their cardamom tea. The tea consists of fragrant black tea gently simmered with cardamom and served in a large tea pot. The fried food was drenched down with a hot cup of tea. Empanada's were made from puff pastry, instead of the typical flour dough. Two of the empanadas came with cheese and the other two with beef. Grape leaves were tart and tender. Falafel was crisp and green inside. Fluffy pita bread was served in addition to the sampler. I'd like to try more items off the menu next time around, such as the koshary and hummus. You'll find Egyptian, Levantine, and South American cuisine on the menu. A bit of something for everyone. We were treated to baklava on the house that night. Baklava was a bit on the dry side but still had a nice and sweet taste. The gesture was appreciated. This place is family friendly and the crowd doubled in size later in the night. A belly dancer showed up and was fiercely dancing to the loud music. It was a good night. I can see myself revisiting for lunch or dinner. It's a cool spot to hangout with family or friends. Checkout Pangea Cafe & Grill if you're interested in Mediterranean cuisine with a touch of true hospitality.

title: Review: Paper Co Cafe — 2015-05-21
summary: It was such a hot and sweltering day when I stepped inside Paper Co Cafe. The interior of this cafe has an industrial feel with lots of airy space. I came in on a Saturday afternoon, after attending the Asian Fest. It was quite busy inside because of the church members and their event. Most of the f
body: It was such a hot and sweltering day when I stepped inside Paper Co Cafe. The interior of this cafe has an industrial feel with lots of airy space. I came in on a Saturday afternoon, after attending the Asian Fest. It was quite busy inside because of the church members and their event. Most of the folks were friendly and upbeat though. There were even a few religious books against the shelf and this vintage looking typewriter. The menu against the wall and the arrangement of their teas are unique as well. I ordered an iced vanilla latte with half skim and half whole milk. The service was quick and I had my iced cold coffee in no time. The place was mostly crowded at the time I went, but luckily I snatched a spot on the large table. My iced vanilla latte was nice and crisp. The beans of the coffee were smooth and you could taste the subtle vanilla flavor. Overall, Paper Co is a nice spot to check out. If I ever came here to study/read then I would do so on a weekday, when its probably quiet. Located in the heights and quite out of reach from where I live, but its definitely a nice spot to visit if you're around the area.

title: Review: Papillon International Bakery — 2017-03-23
summary: Unique establishment serving up Armenian goodies which was a first for me. I love visiting international bakeries and was pleased with the items served inside the glass cases. There are so many items to choose from, including packaged goodies that you can take with you. I opted for the vanilla custa
body: Unique establishment serving up Armenian goodies which was a first for me. I love visiting international bakeries and was pleased with the items served inside the glass cases. There are so many items to choose from, including packaged goodies that you can take with you. I opted for the vanilla custard ponchik - which is deep fried bread with a sweet filling. Basically a Mediterranean doughnut. There are many flavours to choose from, in terms of the ponchik, but I liked the option that I settled for. I also ordered the sweet cheese roll. It took a few minutes for my order to be ready. They are made to order and served warm. I enjoyed the creamy custard filling and the crisp dough. The sweet cheese roll was nice and simple. Young women in the front were friendly and attentive. Many families were coming in and out of the bakery - i'm sure its quite popular in the area. Anyway, i'll definitely be back to try other items off the menu. My sweet tooth was satisfied and I left with a happy belly!

title: Review: Path Of Tea — 2016-05-27
summary: Lovely little tea shoppe located in a nice neighborhood. I had been wanting to try this place for awhile and decided to visit after a nice afternoon at Trader Joe's. My twin sister and I are big tea connoisseurs. We have so many types of tea at home and were delighted to see a great selection at Pat
body: Lovely little tea shoppe located in a nice neighborhood. I had been wanting to try this place for awhile and decided to visit after a nice afternoon at Trader Joe's. My twin sister and I are big tea connoisseurs. We have so many types of tea at home and were delighted to see a great selection at Path of Tea. We wanted something without caffeine, so we decided on the 'yummy bear tea'. Opted for the mini hazelnut and chocolate cake as well. It didn't take too long for our tea to arrive and it was fresh and piping hot. I enjoyed the taste of the 'yummy bear tea', it was fruity yet floral as well. The mini cake paired nicely with the tea. It's a nice and small little shop, a few people were hanging out with friends and a few others were working on their laptop. They have a lovely display of tea mugs. You get to choose the mug in which you sip and savor your tea. I liked this idea. They have a few products for purchase here as well. I definitely see myself coming back and enjoying a variety of other tea's next time around! Check it out.

title: Review: Peyton And Byrne — 2017-12-22
summary: Definitely worth visiting before or after checking out the Greenwich Market. I happened to stumble upon this place after strolling through the market. Glad to have found it. The lovely display of cakes and pastries looking throw the window was tempting enough. Lucky for me, I ended up eating a healt
body: Definitely worth visiting before or after checking out the Greenwich Market. I happened to stumble upon this place after strolling through the market. Glad to have found it. The lovely display of cakes and pastries looking throw the window was tempting enough. Lucky for me, I ended up eating a healthy, colorful and tasty lunch here. It was quite crowded inside on a Saturday afternoon. Ordered a grain and herb salad with a honey baked gooseberry and stilton cheese tart. The salad was crisp, fresh and brimming with fresh herbs. The tart was buttery, cheesy with a sweet mellow taste from the gooseberries. It was a lovely vegetarian meal that went well together. Had a pot of rose tea as well and asked for a small bit of honey. The rose tea was soothing and delightful. Paired quite well with the meal. Peyton and Bryne offer a great selection of sandwiches, salads, tarts, and pastries. Everything is made fresh and makes for a quick meal. They have some nice tasting coffee as well. Service was a bit rushed on such a busy day. There's a diverse selection of cafes in the area. Peyton and Bryne stood out like a classic cafe to try when in London. Definitely left satisfied. Nice neighborhood with many shops and galleries. It'd probably drop by again if visiting in the near future.

title: Review: Pho Ben — 2016-06-22
summary: Always such tasty Vietnamese food! It's literally in my neighborhood and I find myself coming here a few times around. I should visit more often as its convenient, clean, and has simple and light food. I enjoy Vietnamese cuisine, as many of the foods are crisp, fresh and not greasy. Pho Ben has grea
body: Always such tasty Vietnamese food! It's literally in my neighborhood and I find myself coming here a few times around. I should visit more often as its convenient, clean, and has simple and light food. I enjoy Vietnamese cuisine, as many of the foods are crisp, fresh and not greasy. Pho Ben has great prices and the portions of the food are quite large. They only use the freshest ingredients. Every time I come here, my belly feels happy and full, and I often have leftovers. This place is almost always packed, but you are guaranteed to find a table anyway. Tucked in the suburbs, you'll mostly see big groups of family's chowing down on some good grub. I have tried the banh mi here, rice noodle bowls, and fried rice with shrimp. Everything that I have ordered here has always been flavorful and colorful. The food is generously topped with fresh herbs and vegetables. I recommend this small restaurant if you're looking into something nice and different. In this hot and lengthy summer heat, I most definitely recommend the rice noodle bowls. They are crisp, light, and full of flavour. Yummo. Until next time!

title: Review: Pho Saigon — 2015-05-16
summary: Something about this location.. its completely off putting. I happened to be in the area so I decided to try Pho Saigon. I do know there are several locations scattered around the city as well. The establishment is well known in Houston and I thought I would be getting some good food from here. It m
body:
Something about this location.. its completely off putting. I happened to be in the area so I decided to try Pho Saigon. I do know there are several locations scattered around the city as well. The establishment is well known in Houston and I thought I would be getting some good food from here.
It my first time trying Pho Saigon.. and i'm not sure if I want to try it out again. The atmosphere was bleak and the restaurant wasn't that clean. It was quite empty as well. Our waiter didn't seem to have much knowledge in the cuisine either. My mom ordered the shrimp vermicelli bowl and my sister ordered shrimp with steamed rice. They were given a bowl of a typical condiment that consists of vinegar, fish sauce, and sugar. They generously applied this sauce to their meals. The smell of the fish sauce and vinegar was overwhelming and off putting. The shrimp looked dry and had a white-ish color to them. I could tell that they did not enjoy their meals. Luckily I ordered off the menu. I opted for a crispy tofu banh mi which turned out to be tasty. The tofu was filling and the bread was crunchy and fresh. So were the vegetables tucked inside the sandwich. But would I go back here just for a banh mi? Probably not. There are plenty other Vietnamese restaurant's in Houston that I frequent every now and then. This restaurant didn't deliver so much.. and I probably wont be back.

title: Review: Phoenicia Specialty Foods — 2010-05-29
summary: There's nothing like an ethnic specialty food market! These are the types of markets where you find hidden food treasures. Being as I am, very much into cooking, I feel as if this is the one stop shop place for my foodie menu. I can find all sorts of unique items in the produce, dry goods, and meats
body:
There's nothing like an ethnic specialty food market! These are the types of markets where you find hidden food treasures.
Being as I am, very much into cooking, I feel as if this is the one stop shop place for my foodie menu. I can find all sorts of unique items in the produce, dry goods, and meats section.
As soon as you enter, take a left. Once you`ve done that look above you! There`s a marvelous conveyor belt churning up puffy, fresh, pita breads. Pick up any of the packages of breads, and you will notice the steam against the bag, and how the bread just feels in your hands. Freshness at its finest!
Whenever I drop by to Phoenicia, I take quite some time venturing around the very tall aisles filled with items. It`s even more wonderful that this market has a section with a cafe and bakery. There`s nothing like chowing down on a roasted chicken wrap with garlic sauce, and moving a long with your cart at the same time. Hehe. Multi tasking at its finest. ;) They have an area filled with tables where you can sit down as well. The dessert items in the bakery are just eye pleasing, as well as delicious. Try the Kanafeh, which is a sweet cheese dessert, topped with semolina (halva) layered on top. The Baklava`s are great here as well. I`m kinda tired of those, but this place makes some juicy and filling Baklava`s. For a savoury baked treat, I suggest trying the Spanokopita.
Honestly, I squeal in delight when I come across an item that I usually do not find anywhere else! It also comes to mind that I can use these items to create delicious concoctions.
Check out Phoenicia. You`ll never want to leave! ;)

Anyway, i'm totally looking forward to visiting the food truck again. Maybe i'll get to try the store front one day. It's not that far - maybe 25ish mins away from me - but i'm usually never in that area (Cinco Ranch). This sweet tooth gal will continue to support local business. Fresh and local are best! True pies that are proudly made and proudly satisfying. :) Cheers, until next time.

title: Review: Pythagoras Conscious Food Philosophy — 2022-07-06

body:
Such a cozy little spot! I'm liking this conscious food philosophy on a quiet yet nonchalant corner of Sugar Creek plaza. I've always liked this little part of town and Pythagoras vegan cafe is a warm and bright welcome in the area. I met up with friends this evening and we all enjoyed our meals. Despite the menu being primarily of vegan food choices; there really is something for everyone here. The menu is chock full of pizza choices, soups, salads and Persian food items. We started with their loaded vegan nachos as an appetizer and it was quite filling and crisp. Plenty of veggies and the vegan cheese doused on top had a good flavor. Nachos were light and a great sharing item with friends. I'm not vegan but I enjoy eating fresh vegan and vegetarian foods as often as possible. I love the fresh breads here; such as their sesame bread that comes with their Persian style eggplant dip. Delish. As well as their pizzas; the crust is crispy and the toppings are generous. I'm typically not a fan of vegan cheese, but theirs is quite good. I recommend their grapefruit sparkling drink (non-alcoholic) or their juices. It's great to have a new vegan food joint in the area. The theme of the restaurant is unique and their service was warm and efficient. Our waiter was friendly, communicative and often checked up on us.
Thanks dear Pythagoras for enlightening our minds on a random summer evening. It's just simple Pythagorean math; our bellies were full and our hearts felt warm. What more would you want?

title: Review: Red Circle Ice Cream — 2018-02-08
summary: I came here one week ago with my friends after having dinner in the area. It's nice to finally have this dessert concept in Houston. body: I came here one week ago with my friends after having dinner in the area. It's nice to finally have this dessert concept in Houston. There are plenty of ice cream shops with the same concept in Los Angeles. It's a unique dessert trend consisting of bubble waffles and churros which are all customizable. Even though I was full from dinner.. I wanted to try their ice cream. Menu is simple and I knew exactly what I wanted. Opted for soft serve which is one of my favorites. I enjoyed the frosty churro which consisted of vanilla soft serve and two cinnamon churros. The soft serve was creamy and very sweet. Maybe a bit too sweet for my liking. The texture and flavor wasn't bad, but I'd have to say that McDonald's makes a better soft serve. The churros were warm and crispy. They had a solid texture which complimented the soft serve nicely. You can order a cinnamon churro separately by itself. It had a good taste, so I might do that next time. There are a few additional toppings to choose from for the ice cream. I didn't opt for an extra topping on my soft serve. It would have been way too sweet. My friends enjoyed their dessert concoctions as well. I tried a piece of the bubble waffle from my friend and it had a nice and crisp texture. I prefer soft and eggy bubble waffles.. but in this case a crisp waffle would hold the ice cream better. All in all, we enjoyed our evening. Red Circle has great customer service and decent desserts. They close late which is also a bonus. Its a nice spot to visit with friends or family. I'll definitely try something new when I visit next time.

body:
Red Mango is situated in the cute area of Rice Village. On such a hot and muggy night, my friends and I decided to finally try out this place. I did my research ahead of time and checked out their website. Turns out that Red Mango is a huge franchise that is located all around the world. With that in mind, I knew that I was going to dive in some delicious and popular yogurt..
The cute yogurt bar was packed inside with young people, families, and friends. I noticed their beautiful photography inside and how nicely the place was arranged. Unfortunately, their is limited seating inside.
There are only about a couple of yogurt flavours to choose from. In season was white peach, which I sampled. Personally I believe it was overly sweet and lacked in peachy - goodness flavour. I sampled tangomonium, which is a refreshing citrus blend flavour. I fell in love with the taste so I decided to order that. In my tangomonium cup, the server added heaping toppings of mochi, chunks of mango, and raspberries.
Overall, a pleasant and refreshing blend of flavours in my mouth. The yogurt here is thick and dense. You can actually taste and enjoy it. I ordered a small cup and was satisfied. Red Mango creates your flavour and toppings, so it`s not a self serve yogurt bar. The good factor is that you receive a nice cup professionally arranged for you. :)

body:

Bring in a cutesy eco friendly tote when dropping by at the market! You will need it. Support the choice of fresh foods!

title: Review: Ruchi’s Indian Cuisine — 2024-10-06
summary: I don't think this restaurant has even been opened for a year but man its poppin', the flavors, the service, everything. body:
I don't think this restaurant has even been opened for a year but man its poppin', the flavors, the service, everything. This gem of a spot is located within the Spring Branch area.. a part of town thats typically not known for Indian food. Everything about Ruchi's was perfect. Down to their service, warm environment and tantalizing food. Wow! I asked the Non-Indian servers if the chefs were Indian.. and she said yes.. in fact they are South Indian.
Perfect! No wonder the Masala Dosa hit the spot. Huge, full of savory potato filling and complemented with coconut sambar, kurma, etc.
Biryani was pretty good as well. Full of meat, spices and savory goodness. I was amazed at how much food was left over after everyone ate. The food was so delicious that everyone continued to peck at their plates. We got full quick, generous servings that were packed full of flavor. We also like the appetizers served in the beginning, potato veggie samosas that were complemented with green yogurt chutney and tamarind chutney.
Lastly, we enjoyed the Ras Malai, a sweet cottage cheese dumpling dessert that's soaked in a milky saffron base, topped with crushed pistachios and dried rose flowers. Sweet closing to sum up a warm fun-filled night.
All in all, everyone had a good time at this cute little spot tucked out in S.B. They have TVs with colorful music blasting, as well as food travel shows.
Thanks for the warm service and wonderful hospitality. We will surely revisit next time around, perhaps during lunch while sipping on chai and such!
Until next time. ~xoxoxo~

body: Great food and good customer service. Came in with a group of six friends on a random and cold Wednesday night. To our luck, they had a dinner entree + dessert deal for Wednesday. Although i'd say this place is more of an international cafe. Their are desserts to please anyone here, ranging from muffins, scones, crepes, etc. I tried the coffee here..and it was stellar. Warm with a roasted taste and wholesome. Had an apple empanada which I asked to be toasted. It was fresh, soft and doughy. I believe I spoke to the manager who was friendly and welcoming. He mentioned that all of the empanadas are baked and not fried. The flavor of the apple empanada reminded me of apple pie, with small chunks of apples clinging to a spiced and fragrant sauce. I give three stars because some of the items are pricey and you'll need a credit card for purchases lower than $10. I'll be visiting soon again to try other items off the menu such as the alfajores (shortbread cookie sandwiched between a layer of dulce de leche [milk caramel]) and the savory items off the menu. Their werent too many people inside when I visited on a Saturday afternoon. Nice and cozy cafe when passing through the inner loop.

title: Review: Sabai Thai Cafe — 2010-05-09
summary: Ah! Sabai! It`s been my spot for delicious Thai food for four years?! Wow, time flies. I`ve been here many of times with my friends, its our little get together spot. This place has many fond memories for me. The restaurant has undergone design and change over the years. Nonetheless, I still enjoy t
body:
Ah! Sabai! It`s been my spot for delicious Thai food for four years?! Wow, time flies. I`ve been here many of times with my friends, its our little get together spot. This place has many fond memories for me.
The restaurant has undergone design and change over the years. Nonetheless, I still enjoy the ambiance. In Thai, the word 'Sabai' literally translates to a place for relaxation, as well as comfort. Well, they keep their word with that! I particularly enjoy dining here at night. The place is cozy and lit up.
My favourite items on the menu would be their 'Pad Kee Mao', 'Pad Thai', as well as their Fish Cakes. Exotic, and spicy. I also absolutely love their curry noodle soup! Wow, its delicious. The waiter serves you a big bowl full of spicy yellow curry, and rice noodles. I believe its a new dish added to their menu. I have enjoyed it twice so far. Their 'Thai Tea' and their 'Thai Iced Coffee' are quite refreshing to the taste buds after chowing down on some exotic goodness.
Mm, I can almost smell the fragrant Thai basil wafting with red chili. This is the place to be when you want to give your tummy some grown up comfort food.

title: Review: Saigon Pho and Grill — 2016-02-11
summary: Pretty decent tasting Vietnamese food in a clean and spacious environment. I like the classical music playing inside as I enjoy a healthy and colorful meal here. I've been to Saigon Pho & Grill twice so far.. and I have to say that its good. But my favourite in Sugar Land will always be Pho Ben. Whe
body: Pretty decent tasting Vietnamese food in a clean and spacious environment. I like the classical music playing inside as I enjoy a healthy and colorful meal here. I've been to Saigon Pho & Grill twice so far.. and I have to say that its good. But my favourite in Sugar Land will always be Pho Ben. When I first came here.. I ordered soft tofu rolls and a tofu banh mi. Unfortunately, the tofu was missing inside of the soft roll. All I got was lettuce and noodles inside my roll. Where was the tofu? It was the main ingredient which was missing. Well... the world may never know. Haha! As far as the banh mi goes.. it was delicious and satisfying. The tofu inside the sandwich was crispy.. as was the bread. The vegetables inside were fresh and crunchy. I no longer have to make the drive to China Town when craving a good banh mi sandwich. Second time around I came here.. I was craving a big bowl of vermicelli noodles with crispy tofu and vegetables. Well.. that is exactly what I got here. It was delicious and healthy. Although I would have liked fresh herbs on top of the vermicelli bowl. Adding fresh herbs always brings out the flavor of an item. It's one of my favorite dishes as its light and the noodles are boiled and not fried. I also ordered the shrimp soft rolls. They were generously filled with plump and juicy shrimp. The peanut sauce always goes nice with this tasty item. Even though I was hungry and ate a lot for my standards.. I had plenty of leftovers to take home. The cafe su da (Vietnamese iced coffee) is always a crisp and caffeinated drink when in the mood for a buzz. I may be back for the tofu sandwich and to try out other items from the menu (vegetarian pho & such).

title: Review: Sambalatte — 2016-04-15
summary: Probably the best and most unique coffee house on the strip. Literally - the strip is cluttered with cookie cutter restaurants and chains. Sitting down and sipping on some exotic coffee here was pleasant and relaxing - I literally felt like I was no longer in Vegas.. Which is exactly what I needed t
body: Probably the best and most unique coffee house on the strip. Literally - the strip is cluttered with cookie cutter restaurants and chains. Sitting down and sipping on some exotic coffee here was pleasant and relaxing - I literally felt like I was no longer in Vegas.. Which is exactly what I needed to feel. I like the aesthetics, ambiance and feel of this place. Nice lights, colors, and overall interior design is lovely. I have a thing for rose flavored foods and drinks - so I truly enjoyed the rose petal latte. It is a coffee beverage that I literally cannot find anywhere else, unless I make something similar at home. It was foamy, warm, sweet and pleasantly scented. Come and try this unique latte at the Sambalatte. They have nice pastries as well. I opted for the banana bread - It was thick and dense, with good flavor. It wasnt too sweet. I would totally visit this cafe next time around, but I barely visit Vegas. Try this coffee house if you love lattes and anything coffee related. Staff isn't that warm and the prices are a bit steep.. but it's Vegas. Oh well. Its a nice little spot to relax and catch-up with others if you're in the area.

title: Review: Seiwa Market — 2021-11-04
summary: I like this market! It's a small specialty market displaying products specifically from Japan. Have visited a few times in the past. The market is always clean and provides just a few items. It's always spotless and doesn't smell too strong inside. The fresh produce is a hit or miss, for instance, t
body: I like this market! It's a small specialty market displaying products specifically from Japan. Have visited a few times in the past. The market is always clean and provides just a few items. It's always spotless and doesn't smell too strong inside. The fresh produce is a hit or miss, for instance, the cilantro was limp and flat. Cherry tomatoes were fresh and bursting in color. There's quite a sticker shock to many of their shelf products! The prices have gone up as well with related exported items. Many of their salad dressings and other items are quite up in price. They have their special kewpie mayo and other Japanese products you may not find at regular grocery stores. Their fresh food section was minimum and bare, although I visited earlier in the afternoon. Not entirely sure if I would purchase fresh sushi from here anyway. Their packaged chocolate bourbon biscuits are great. Very chocolatey and crisp. I love picking up their savory rice cracker snacks as well, this time I opted for the wasabi rice cracker snacks. They've got plenty of iced coffee and tea cans/bottles that are ready made to drink. Some of the beverages have tapioca pearls in em. Others have coffee and no cream. My favorite being Sangaria: Royal milk tea. Still, nothing can beat a drink that's made fresh in house, but the Sangaria brand makes a clean drink with just a few ingredients. Not that sweet either, a simple pick me up. This plaza with Seiwa has several shoppes nearby. Quiet and unassuming little area of Houston. Tucked away in a corner. Check out this market and several other related international markets. Support local, as always.

title: Review: Sephora at Kohl’s — 2023-12-09
summary: So this is a new location of Sephora and they have been open since June 2023. Walk inside Kohl's and you'll spot Sephora's fairly decent sized kiosk store to the left side of the store. I can't remember the last time I visited a Kohl's location, but this made for a good walk and fun visit. I actuall
body:
So this is a new location of Sephora and they have been open since June 2023.
Walk inside Kohl's and you'll spot Sephora's fairly decent sized kiosk store to the left side of the store. I can't remember the last time I visited a Kohl's location, but this made for a good walk and fun visit.
I actually like this location! It's smaller compared to their regular stores yet they pretty much have every item that you would find at regular Sephora stores. Lotions, fragrances and gift items? Check. You'll find it here. This location is less crowded and you'll find what you need within a minute. There aren't people bumping or pushing against you at their other stuffy locations that reek of perfume and blush.
Customer service was great, I was greeted upon visiting and had all my questions answered. Found what that I was looking for and that's all there is to it. I was able to use my account points and they also gave a discount with it being the holidays. Perfect! Although the Galleria location is much closer to me, I can definitely see myself revisiting this one more often.
This new location of Sephora is in one of my favorite parts of town. I love how new businesses continue to develop within this west Houston urban neighborhood.
This business location needs to be revamped with saying "now opened" instead of coming soon.
You're welcome and enjoy. SYOY.

title: Review: Shake Shack Las Vegas - NYNY Hotel — 2016-05-27
profile: Shake Shack Las Vegas - NYNY Hotel
summary: Yum! I made sure to try out Shake Shack in LV, since I missed out in NYC (where its originally from). So the lines here are always incredibly long, but the process was pretty quick. Didn't have to wait for too long. Nice and open space with many windows and proper seating. Their were many young peop
body: Yum! I made sure to try out Shake Shack in LV, since I missed out in NYC (where its originally from). So the lines here are always incredibly long, but the process was pretty quick. Didn't have to wait for too long. Nice and open space with many windows and proper seating. Their were many young people here just chowin down on some fancy fast food grub. I opted for the mushroom burger (its a fried mushroom burger with cheese). Felt like eating vegetarian, as its the option I primarily try to choose when dining out. Ordered some fries and the chocolate concrete as well. The food was decent, mushroom burger was a bit on the small side. It was a bit difficult to eat as the mushroom became rubbery and chewing after getting fried. French fries were okay. The chocolate concrete with the chocolate sprinkles was probably the best thing I ate. It was creamy and luscious. Their were a few brownie bits sprinkled in, but definitely not enough. Overall, my experience at Shake Shack was okay, not too bad. I'll definitely try something new off the menu if and when I visit. Supposedly they'll be bringing a location to Houston, TX. Until then!

title: Review: Sharetea — Houston — 2016-05-15
summary: Lovely authentic Taiwanese style tapioca drinks here! Boba was originated in Taiwan, so you definitely know these guys are onto something with their concept. This cafe is small and brightly lit with many chairs and tables to situate yourself. They have WiFi and great internet connection. This is the
body: Lovely authentic Taiwanese style tapioca drinks here! Boba was originated in Taiwan, so you definitely know these guys are onto something with their concept. This cafe is small and brightly lit with many chairs and tables to situate yourself. They have WiFi and great internet connection. This is the place to be when needing to work on something online, studying or reading a book. Although it can be a little loud. But again, if you're doing some light research online or working on a simple task, I recommend this cafe over the other ones in China Town. I'm here writing this review and surfing the web. Ordered the honey milk tea with tapioca. Highly recommended. Its sweet, crisp, and has the right amount of tapioca and ice. I would probably have it sweetened a bit less next time around. Looking forward to coming back again and maybe trying the Okinawa milk tea (sweetened with roasted brown sugar). This place is almost always packed with super long lines. Luckily i'm here on a rainy Sunday evening, so it hasn't been crazy busy. But I recommend trying this place anyhow when in the area. Share tea = share happiness!

title: Review: Sharetea — Sugar Land — 2017-01-02
summary: Yey! Welcome to the neighborhood Sharetea. :) Its great to have you in Sugar Land - this town just got sweeter! I came here around 9:30 pm on new years eve. body:
Yey! Welcome to the neighborhood Sharetea. :)
Its great to have you in Sugar Land - this town just got sweeter!
I came here around 9:30 pm on new years eve. My sisters and I were happy they were open at that time. I was craving a crisp tapioca beverage on such a warm night. This location has nice lighting and a cool vibe. There are plenty of chairs and tables to situate yourself upon. I got my usual favorite beverage - tapioca milk tea. It was crisp, sweet and the pearls were perfect. I chose 80% sweetener with medium ice. There weren't any long lines so we received our drinks rather quickly.The workers were friendly and gave us new stamp cards. We couldn't use the stamp cards from the other location since they are different owners. No worries. Anyway, we enjoyed our drinks and my sisters cocoa milk was pretty good as well. I didn't find the drinks to be too sweet - they were just fine. You can adjust to your liking anyway. :) I like how they have a few selected drink choices. Just straight and simple. No Thai tea, almond milk tea, etc. There are a few other places in the hood' to grab those kinda drinks. I'm looking forward to going back to Share Tea in SL. Until next time! ;)

body: Donuts were old and cold. Greasy and stale upon holding the darn donut. Although known to be 24 hrs, this location totally does not serve warm nor fresh donuts. title: Review: Shipley Do-Nuts — Sugar Land — 2016-05-28
summary: Some of my favorite donuts are found in this location of Shipleys! This popular donut franchise is settled in a clean and quaint neighborhood in Sugar Land. In close proximity to everything that's around me. Their are many shops tucked in the plaza and its one of my favorite places to stroll around
body: Some of my favorite donuts are found in this location of Shipleys! This popular donut franchise is settled in a clean and quaint neighborhood in Sugar Land. In close proximity to everything that's around me. Their are many shops tucked in the plaza and its one of my favorite places to stroll around the area. After grabbing some donuts, I often walk into Half Priced Books and just enjoy my leisurely afternoon. Or sometime's I'll get my nails done at Nails By Yen, tucked in the corner of that plaza. Anyhow, the donuts here are fresh and the icing is always crisp. I recommend the butterfly roll, which literally tastes like a cinnamon roll combined into a donut. Twisty and delish! The apple fritters are great here as well, big, crisp and loaded with chunks of diced apple. My other favorites are the cake donuts (plain, glazed and blueberry). A small grab and go location yet it has everything you need to satisfy your donut cravings! Sweetly loaded yet oh so yummy! Try out this location in Sugar Land if in the area!

title: Review: Shogi Hibachi Express — 2010-05-03
summary: Mm hibachi! & double thumbs up for express! This place has an awesome concept. I recently came in here for lunch with a group of friends. We were seated promptly, and had the best service. body:
Mm hibachi! & double thumbs up for express!
This place has an awesome concept. I recently came in here for lunch with a group of friends. We were seated promptly, and had the best service. The staff is very kind and helpful.
I`m a big fan of hot and sizzling food. Basically you get to choose your meats, vegetables, spices and sauces. Jazz it up, and be comfortable with what you create. Once you are done picking your ingredients, you hand over your bowl to the chef who cooks it up. The service is quick, and you receive your yummy creation as soon as possible. I choose a blend of Sichuan sauce and Teriyaki sauce. It complimented my dish well, with the blend of spicy and sweet.
I`ll be coming back soon enough. Probably even sooner?
This week. Yes. =)

title: Review: Six Ping — 2012-03-20
summary: Six Ping is a nice and tidy bakery located in a bustling shopping district. I have tried their sweet breads, and they are nothing but moist and flaky. The breads are baked daily, and are lightly sweetened. They have various and unique flavors to select from. I have had their croissant, coconut bread
body: Six Ping is a nice and tidy bakery located in a bustling shopping district. I have tried their sweet breads, and they are nothing but moist and flaky. The breads are baked daily, and are lightly sweetened. They have various and unique flavors to select from. I have had their croissant, coconut bread, and pound cakes.
