I love the fact that these baked goodies are light and flavorful.

title: Review: Slim Chickens — 2023-07-18
summary: Hmm Slim Chickens! More like the bare bones of it. A place that I had high expectations for, but to be honest, those expectations fell flat upon first sight and bite. I was excited to try this spot and have noticed it in different parts of Houston but happened to be out in the city of Pears and foun
body:
Hmm Slim Chickens! More like the bare bones of it. A place that I had high expectations for, but to be honest, those expectations fell flat upon first sight and bite.
I was excited to try this spot and have noticed it in different parts of Houston but happened to be out in the city of Pears and found it out of happenstance. Twas' evening time and the hunger pangs began for a snack. Something not too heavy, but not too light. My initial thoughts were to visit Canes because I was craving their sauce and tenders, but didn't know which side of Pearland it was at. Slims popped up during my excursion and I thought.. well why not? I've seen this spot before so lets give it a shot.
Ordered their simple meal of tenders that came with fries and texas toast. Also ordered their fried mushrooms as well. The fried mushrooms were bomb! Incredibly warm and crispy. They had good texture and taste. I wish I could say the same for the rest of my meal, but everything else was OK (fries and tenders). The tenders weren't that crispy, maybe because of all that buttermilk batter? They were also a bit small. Fries weren't crispy, mostly soft. Texas toast was buttery and garlicky, it was average in taste. I was excited to try their Slims sauce, which I was told was similar to Canes. At least that's what the drive thru staff said. With excitement I asked for 2 orders of their Slims sauce. To my surprise, it did not taste anything similar to Canes sauce. Instead it was very creamy and tomato flavored in taste. Almost like a cream of tomato soup which did not pair well with any of the items that were ordered. I also asked for ranch sauce as well which they forgot to add to my order when I left - that would have been the saving grace to those tenders. With a plethora of sauce that this place has to offer, I'm sure that I would have a better experience with a different flavor profile. But will I be back? I'm not too sure. I do like how they offer other items on their menu such as sandwiches and wraps. Might visit another location within the Houston area. I was just left unimpressed. Thankfully the meal wasn't as salty or aggressively fried in flavor as other fast foods spots. Slim' ranking for this spot. But might revisit if having a hankering for some tenders. Unless I'm cravin' for another kinda sauce. Until next time.
PS - they are serving up cheesecake desserts & various pudding jar desserts... perhaps something sweeter and cooling in this heat would be nice.

title: Review: Soju Bar — 2021-11-02
summary: Service is completely non-existent at this late night spot. Its a Korean style bar/small restaurant serving up decent food with large prices yet large portions. It is sorely disappointing how bad the service is. I do believe this place has potential but there's a lackluster and 'i don't care' feelin
body: Service is completely non-existent at this late night spot. Its a Korean style bar/small restaurant serving up decent food with large prices yet large portions. It is sorely disappointing how bad the service is. I do believe this place has potential but there's a lackluster and 'i don't care' feeling to it. You won't even receive a menu upon seating, you'll receive it several minutes later when the waitress is free to hand it to you. Upon ordering your meal, be prepared to receive it quite late. All food items come out at the same time -- at least give customers their appetizers as they wait for an eternity for their main meal. I ordered the soft tofu soup which is typically served vegetarian unless you ask them to add meat (ie; chicken or pork). My tofu soup came with pork which was a complete disaster since the food arrived wrong and I knew it would take forever to make something new. I just simply swapped my meal with my friend. Appetizers were crisp and fresh, you can't mess up anything that is fried. The banchan here is always tasty and they serve items that you may not find at other spots. Their kimchi is spicy and pungent. Goes great with the stews (so long as they don't mess up the order). I have tried their seafood pancake in the past which was tasty as well. My standards have always been chill about this spot simply because it's just a chill bar semi restaurant environment. Overall the food isn't bad here, but they really should pay attention to their customers. Place is small and cramped. Could really hire another waiter to help take orders and to overall provide better service. Doubt I'll be back anytime soon. Unique little bar/food spot nonetheless.

title: Review: Soliz Casa De Tacos — 2018-04-05
summary: I don't wanna taco bout' it.. but these tacos were muy malo (really bad). My twin sister and I visited Soliz Casa De Tacos last week after running a few errands. We got there 30 minutes before closing and decided to sit inside and eat a light lunch. Service was awkward and the folks behind the count
body:
I don't wanna taco bout' it.. but these tacos were muy malo (really bad).
My twin sister and I visited Soliz Casa De Tacos last week after running a few errands. We got there 30 minutes before closing and decided to sit inside and eat a light lunch. Service was awkward and the folks behind the counter could have been friendlier. They seem warmer with their regular customers. Menu is decently large and consists of combination plates, menudo, and barbacoa. They have a few side items and drinks to choose from as well. The most popular items on the menu would be any of their breakfast tacos. These tacos are what everyone has been drawn to for the past few decades. But I really wasn't impressed.
I ordered the Eric taco which consisted of eggs, potatoes, onions, cheese and guac. I couldn't taste any of the ingredients except for the potatoes. It was just a starchy mess. The eggs were scattered inside the tortilla and resembled confetti. This is a breakfast taco and the primary ingredient should have been the eggs. My sister felt the same way about her taco. Very skimpy and lacked any flavor. The tortilla had a smokey taste which was off-putting as well. Salsa had a decent flavor and covered up the taste of the lackluster taco. On a further note, the beans are cooked with pork, so it's an item that isn't vegetarian friendly.
The inside of Soliz is clean and newly renovated. But would I revisit on any further occasion? Probably not. Raize's is on the same street and has better tasting tacos with a better price tag and generous ingredients.

title: Review: SomiSomi — 2024-11-02
summary: Somisomi Is so so yummy yummy. I'm liking this location out in Katy. A little small within the interior, but most locations seem to be that way. It's a grab and go ice cream spot that fills up quickly. The lines are long yet it moves rather fast. Customer service is good and you get to watch your de
body:
Somisomi
Is so so yummy yummy.
I'm liking this location out in Katy. A little small within the interior, but most locations seem to be that way. It's a grab and go ice cream spot that fills up quickly. The lines are long yet it moves rather fast. Customer service is good and you get to watch your dessert being made. I've always liked Korean style soft serve. So fluffy, soft and creamy. Very milky as well and not too sweet. They seem to often have a new flavor and that is what I like about this spot. They had a sweet corn flavor mixed with their horchata flavor and it was good. A bit more on the mellow side but it still has a nice aroma and flavor. Their crispy fish shaped waffle is so yummy. I love loading it up with vanilla custard. Their dusting of matcha on top of soft serve is chef's kiss. Flavors are good and portions are plenty.
You can't go wrong with SomiSomi as a cooling and creamy dessert option after having savory bite to eat within the area. With so much to see and do in this part of town, it's no wonder that SomiSomi is on the list for something delectable while out in this part of town. Creamy and dreamy. Until we meet again!

title: Review: Southern Maid Donuts — 2016-10-09
summary: Crisp and fresh donuts! Came here just the other day and grabbed a few cake donuts and old fashioned donuts. The plain cake was my favorite, nice and simple. The glazed donuts were too sweet for my liking but they were still nice and fresh, paired with hot plain coffee without sugar. I also tried th
body: Crisp and fresh donuts! Came here just the other day and grabbed a few cake donuts and old fashioned donuts. The plain cake was my favorite, nice and simple. The glazed donuts were too sweet for my liking but they were still nice and fresh, paired with hot plain coffee without sugar. I also tried the vegetarian breakfast taco consisting of egg, cheese and potato. It wasn't the best I've tried but it wasn't too bad either. The taco curbed my craving and filled me up early in the morning without the dreaded fear of a sugar crash. I did have to heat up the taco once I got home, because it was a bit cold. All in all, I enjoyed the experience here at Southern Maid and the workers are quite friendly and attentive. I'll definitely drop by if i'm in the area. I do believe they close early and the best time to head out here is in the morning.

title: Review: Southside Espresso — 2014-01-09
summary: Came in here on a very cold and windy Sunday night.. and the cafe was packed. I'd been wanting to try this place since the summer, so was finally content to try it recently. Came in here with the sisters to meet up with a good friend of ours and enjoyed our stay. Although there were many people alre
body: Came in here on a very cold and windy Sunday night.. and the cafe was packed. I'd been wanting to try this place since the summer, so was finally content to try it recently. Came in here with the sisters to meet up with a good friend of ours and enjoyed our stay. Although there were many people already seated inside, we were still able to find ourselves a small table. It was nice and cozy inside without being too loud. We all ordered different beverages and enjoyed them. I had ordered a cafe latte with almond syrup. I enjoyed the fact that the almond flavored latte wasn't strikingly sweet. Nor did the drink taste too strong of almond, as those artificial type of beverages usually do. I can tell that the syrups in the beverages are of high quality. Overall, I enjoyed my cafe latte. It was smooth, silky, and foamy. My sister enjoyed her hibiscus tea which had a nice strong taste. It was flavourful with fruity and fragrant notes. I also ordered a brownie which had a nice home made taste to it. It was soft and cake like, which I didnt mind. The cocoa flavor was potent and the brownie wasn't too sweet either. Oh and last thing.. the service at Southside Espresso was great. We were greeted warmly by the kind and patient staff. We were also given glasses of water later on without being asked. I will definitely drop by next time i'm around the area. Looking forward to visiting on an afternoon day. I'm sure there are more pastries in stock in the afternoon as well.

title: Review: Sprinkles Houston Westheimer — 2024-02-01
summary: Oh Sprinkles, Your cupcakes have become drier than a boring brick wall. What happened? Within the span of two months I have visited twice. During both occasions the environment was bleak and dry, just as their latest installation of cupcakes churning out. Not sure what's goin' on but this used to be
body:
Oh Sprinkles,
Your cupcakes have become drier than a boring brick wall. What happened? Within the span of two months I have visited twice. During both occasions the environment was bleak and dry, just as their latest installation of cupcakes churning out. Not sure what's goin' on but this used to be the happening place for cupcakes. Especially for all of those uptown vibe folks. Ironically their latest installation of all things cookies and brownies are far tastier and tender compared to their brick version of cupcakes. Again, the cupcakes are dry these days and are lacking flavor. Way too sweet and dry. This place used to have such tender cuppycakes and the environment used to be completely different. Warmer, softer and sweeter is how it used to be, ahem, just like their cupcakes. Should they change their name Sprinkles Cookies? Maybe. Brownies and cookies are baked fresh in house daily. Other than that, Sprinkles has a small selection of decadent treats. May need to reconsider and find another sweet tooth spot for cupcakes+ other treats because this place ain't racking up. Nevermind the 24/7 ATM cupcake machine in the back. Sometimes it doesn't work. Other than that, I hope this place does a 360 and finds a way to save their recipe. After all, they should hold on to the namesake of this place.
Moving' on.

title: Review: Starbucks — Sugar Land — 2022-03-14
summary: This is probably one of the better locations of Starbucks in the Sugar Land area. I'm not the biggest fan of SB, but I appreciate this location in regards to their convenience and service. This is the only location in Sugar Land that has a drive thru; and boy is that convenient or what. It makes zip
body: This is probably one of the better locations of Starbucks in the Sugar Land area. I'm not the biggest fan of SB, but I appreciate this location in regards to their convenience and service. This is the only location in Sugar Land that has a drive thru; and boy is that convenient or what. It makes zipping in and out rather quick and speedy. Their service is just as fast and friendly. They made me a cafe misto today, which is probably my favorite beverage at SB, when done right. They made it tall, warm and frothy, just perfect. It was steamed well and scented with just a bit of vanilla syrup. I realized I needed just a bit more syrup so they handed me an extra cup; how sweet is that? The workers here are friendly and deserve good tips. This location is nostalgic for me; all things quaint and cosy area within the burbs'. It's been a part of the neighborhood forever. There are schools and neighborhoods nearby that I am quite familiar with. If anyone knows me well enough, a warm good cup of coffee makes my day. Thankfully this location always pulls through and does just that. I'll visit from time to time as I prefer to support local businesses over big companies when given the chance. Other SBs can learn from this location; let's make coffee great again.

title: Review: Starbucks — Meadows Place — 2022-01-10
summary: I don't typically write reviews on Starbucks... But this is a brand new location right by Meadows Place in Stafford. It's tucked in the same plaza as Aldi's Grocers. This new location of SB is very clean, quaint and minimal. Cleanliness is such a huge factor right now and they completely ace at it.
body: I don't typically write reviews on Starbucks... But this is a brand new location right by Meadows Place in Stafford. It's tucked in the same plaza as Aldi's Grocers. This new location of SB is very clean, quaint and minimal. Cleanliness is such a huge factor right now and they completely ace at it. I walked inside the shoppe rather than visiting their drive thru. Staff was friendly and whipped me up a nice and warm cafe au lait. With a small drop of vanilla bean flavouring. At SB, it's called a cafe misto, so I make sure to keep that in mind. It's probably the one drink that I like getting here. They made it tall, frothy and fresh. Beans did not taste sour nor rancid. When in the area, while grabbing grocery and such, I may revisit again. I'm glad this part of town is thriving and doing well. Makes the experience more pleasant and comfortable. Until next time.

title: Review: Sugar Land Memorial Park — 2022-01-21
summary: Calm. Clean. Crystal clear. I'm describing this park and the water that stretches throughout the land it's situated on. Very peaceful. You can go fishing near the water or just reflect upon life. I hope you do enough reflections and meditation - maybe this park will inspire you to do just that. I lo
body:
Calm. Clean. Crystal clear.
I'm describing this park and the water that stretches throughout the land it's situated on. Very peaceful. You can go fishing near the water or just reflect upon life. I hope you do enough reflections and meditation - maybe this park will inspire you to do just that. I love visiting this quiet and tucked away park in the winter and spring seasons. Bring your friends, doggie pals and family. You don't hear too much traffic noise, especially as you continue to wander far off into the grass. There are a few unique trees and birds here as well. At the front of the entrance you'll find a cosy yet large pavilion for holding gatherings and picnics. There's a small section of the park that's closed off for now (near the memorial obelisk). Other than that, there's plenty of concrete to stretch your legs and take a walk upon. Keep moving. That's always the goal. You'll find that here.

title: Review: Sugar Thai Fine Cuisine — 2013-06-11
summary: Sugar Thai is a simple and quaint Thai restaurant in Sugar Land. It's fairly new and located in an area that has several cultural restaurants. I ordered the Pad Kee Mao noodles at Sugar Thai recently, and found the dish to be less greasy than most Thai restaurants. The dish was pretty flavourful, bu
body:
Sugar Thai is a simple and quaint Thai restaurant in Sugar Land. It's fairly new and located in an area that has several cultural restaurants.
I ordered the Pad Kee Mao noodles at Sugar Thai recently, and found the dish to be less greasy than most Thai restaurants. The dish was pretty flavourful, but too spicy for my liking. Other than that, I usually love Pad Kee Mao. If I ever order this dish again, i'll probably let them know to tone down the heat level. The pieces of shrimp that came with my dish were juicy and succulent. My sister ordered green curry and found the portion of the dish to be small and the curry to be watery. She is a huge fan of green curry, but did not like her dish at Sugar Thai. The prices of the dishes are steep and overpriced as well.
I may try this restaurant again in the near future. Other than that, I already have a favorite Thai restaurant within the city that I frequent often. I'll most likely stick to going there.

title: Review: Sunday Press — 2023-09-06
summary: My gosh -- the menu here is so colorful, fun and quite extensive. You will find something for everyone here! Rejoice. This colorful cafe in more ways than one is serving up colorful, sweet and intricate food items. Upon first glance -- it's their sweets and treats that keep me coming back for more.
body:
My gosh -- the menu here is so colorful, fun and quite extensive.
You will find something for everyone here! Rejoice. This colorful cafe in more ways than one is serving up colorful, sweet and intricate food items.
Upon first glance -- it's their sweets and treats that keep me coming back for more. Been awhile since I glanced at a marble pound cake, macadamia nut cookie, snickerdoodle and swirly croissants all tucked behind a lovely glass display. Sunday Press has these one of a kind swirl croissants which are hard to find within the city of Houston. This spot serves up these rare gems and on top of that? They're quite good. Great YUM and CRISP factor with the right amount of filling of your choice -- my fav being the matcha swirl croissant. For drinks selections: they've got everything you need! From cafe lattes, tea lattes and many other beverages to choose from - ours being the london fog latte. Sweet. Depth. And just the right amount of bergamot essence kissing the milky foam of the cup. In regards to food, you'll find sandwiches, soups, salad among many other items. Its almost hard to decide -- I was torn between pasta salad or breakfast taco. I went for the brekkie taco and glad I did. It was one taco yet it was filling, warm and with plenty of flavor. I liked how the taco wasn't spicy and that the tortilla was warm, stretchy and fresh. They added plenty of shredded veggies to my veggie breakfast taco. It was filling and made for the perfect meal earlier in the day. If I'm ever here later in the day, I'll definitely opt for some type of salad to go with my tea.
This spot fills up quick! We got here earlier in the morning and witnessed seats disappearing fast. Thankfully they have plenty of seating of all types. Many folks connecting and chatting while others studying or working on their laptops. With decently warm service within a unique colorful environment -- I can definitely see why this place slowly causes traffic jams and gets packed within the day. I envision myself revisiting again sometime soon and ordering a few different items on the menu. Will be back when in the area, which is once in awhile. Thank you Sunday Press for your treats and good vibes.

title: Review: Supreme Roastworks — 2015-08-17
summary: Good solid coffee that reminds me of the amazing spots in Houston (Home). Latte's are super creamy yet light at the same time. The flavor of the beans are fully roasted yet display a smooth taste. My friend got the hot chocolate which looked just as good. The sweets were nice as well, such as the br
body: Good solid coffee that reminds me of the amazing spots in Houston (Home). Latte's are super creamy yet light at the same time. The flavor of the beans are fully roasted yet display a smooth taste. My friend got the hot chocolate which looked just as good. The sweets were nice as well, such as the brownie. Its quite small inside, yet its a nice little spot to drop by with friends.

title: Review: SusieCakes — 2017-12-14
summary: What a beautiful, vibrant and retro bakery! This classic all-American bakery has arrived to Houston via Nor'Cal. I had heard about SusieCakes via instagram and had stumbled upon it on my walk through Rice Village. My family and I were greeted very kindly upon entering.. and all the folk running the
body: What a beautiful, vibrant and retro bakery! This classic all-American bakery has arrived to Houston via Nor'Cal. I had heard about SusieCakes via instagram and had stumbled upon it on my walk through Rice Village. My family and I were greeted very kindly upon entering.. and all the folk running the show were super friendly. Everyone was gleaming with smiles and we felt welcomed. The customer service was phenomenal and we were asked a few times if we had any questions. The desserts behind the counter were glistening and shining with so many colors, shapes and textures. They have so many different options here.. ranging from cupcakes, cake, whoopie pies, cheesecake, bars, etc. I stumbled upon many desserts that I normally wouldn't find at other bakeries --- they simply have classic items on their menu. My family and I all chose the mini cupcakes. We opted for the celebration cupcakes. The icing was a lovely sea blue and the cupcake was mini in size. I thought the cupcake would have funfetti inside.. but it only had funfetti on top of the icing. Unfortunately, the mini cupcake was very dry and crumbly in texture. It might have over-baked in the oven, due to its small size and all. The flavour was great though.. and I enjoyed the taste of the icing and the cake. SusieCakes uses fresh and natural ingredients.. and one can simply tell by taking a bite of their desserts. I like how the desserts arent overly sweet and they have a great taste. My family and I tried the sample of their chocolate and peppermint cake.. it was delish. I might have to grab a large slice of cake next time around. It might not be as dry. The large blue colored celebration cake has my eye as well.. and i'd love to try it even if its not my birthday! :) SusieCakes reminds me of Magnolia Bakery in NYC. Many of their desserts look similar to Magnolia and its nice to have that kind of variety. This charming bakery definitely has potential and I look forward in visiting again. Will update soon.

title: Review: Sweet Lola Yogurt Bar — 2011-09-26
summary: The cutest yogurt boutique shoppe! I finally was able to try out Sweet Lola's yesterday after a delicious brunch of crepes next door at Coco's. Both the outside and inside of Sweet Lola's is attractive. There are lavish displays of candles, stationary sets and everything else that will pamper your s
body:
The cutest yogurt boutique shoppe!
I finally was able to try out Sweet Lola's yesterday after a delicious brunch of crepes next door at Coco's. Both the outside and inside of Sweet Lola's is attractive. There are lavish displays of candles, stationary sets and everything else that will pamper your spirit!
I chose the Royal Pear yogurt and was quite pleased! Pear has to be one of my favourite flavours, and I have never seen it at any other yogurt bar. I also love the fact that there are only about 4 flavours to choose from. It keeps this place nice and simple. All the yogurts are thick and creamy, with a fresh aroma that lingers after eating them. Freshness at its finest. I topped my pear yogurt with tart strawberries and blueberries. I do believe that more fruits could be added to the topping selection, as I am not a fan of eating candies with yogurt. Nonetheless, the yogurt kept me happy as I strolled around the street. It didn't melt quick, which is also a great factor. I will definitely be dropping by again after lunch in the greater Midtown plaza. :)

title: Review: SweetCup — 2015-12-03
summary: Local and fresh gelato! Unfortunately I was not wowed by this place.. I had been wanting to come here for the longest time.. Yet I was not satisfied as I thought I would be. Maybe I came in during the wrong time of the day? My friends and I arrived to SweetCup on a Saturday evening. Most of the flav
body:
Local and fresh gelato! Unfortunately I was not wowed by this place..
I had been wanting to come here for the longest time.. Yet I was not satisfied as I thought I would be. Maybe I came in during the wrong time of the day? My friends and I arrived to SweetCup on a Saturday evening. Most of the flavors were almost finished and the products looked too soft for my liking. I chose two different flavors and I noticed they were too soft as if they had been scooped and mixed all day. The gelato had a melted texture and was not as firm and creamy as I hoped it would be. I did enjoy the flavors of the choices that I picked. The scooper guy was kind enough to allow sampling of many flavours. The cardamom flavour of the malai kulfi was my favorite. The pizzelle cookie that came with the gelato was appreciated as well. Overall, I will definitely visit SweetCup again in the future. Maybe next time in the afternoon, where the flavors will be at their freshest peak of perfection. Other than that, their are some other spots in town that also make pretty decent gelato.

title: Review: t’afia — 2010-08-02
summary: "t'afia!" .. What's it mean? The saying is all in the name. . "t'afia!" means "to your health!" I absolutely love the sheer brilliance Monica Pope has behind her restaurant. Not only does the name stick out, but so does everything else about her idea's. Chef Monica Pope teaches Saturday morning cook
body:
"t'afia!" ..
What's it mean? The saying is all in the name. .
"t'afia!" means "to your health!"
I absolutely love the sheer brilliance Monica Pope has behind her restaurant. Not only does the name stick out, but so does everything else about her idea's.
Chef Monica Pope teaches Saturday morning cooking classes, in which there is no charge, and she uses local produce. I have only came here on a Saturday morning, but was unfortunately late to watch her cooking demonstration.
The Midtown Farmers Market also begins early on Saturday mornings, which is right in front of t'afias.
Around 10 AM, the place was bustling with liveliness with people of all character. For breakfast, t'afia offers egg and ham biscuit sandwiches, chocolate chips scones, iced coffee, and a variety of hot teas (which is provided by katz coffee).
I have enjoyed the environment, and I love the fact that Monica speaks to everyone. It make`s you feel comfortable, as if you are home. I definitely want to drop by here for dinner, which is when she dishes up a concoction of unique locally provided ingredients.

title: Review: Tacos A Go Go — 2010-08-02
summary: Tacos A Go-Go serves up some good tacos. Their isn't anything amazing about the tacos.. they are just okay. The taco shack is definitely a great place to chill with friends. Right when you enter you`ll notice a burst of colours the interior has to offer. One wall has a solid blue wall painted with d
body:
Tacos A Go-Go serves up some good tacos. Their isn't anything amazing about the tacos.. they are just okay.
The taco shack is definitely a great place to chill with friends. Right when you enter you`ll notice a burst of colours the interior has to offer. One wall has a solid blue wall painted with different symbols and pictures. I like the feel of the place. I also love the outside of this place, and how the entrance of the lady wearing a big hat outside just draws you in.
I have tried both the vegetarian and the seafood (fish) taco. They were both good. A bit on the small side though. The fish was fresh, and perfectly grilled. Juicy and moist, the fish complimented well with the coarseness of the corn tortilla.
The SALSA here is all that I will ever truly come back for! It is a beautiful peachy colour. The taste is unique, and unlike the typical tomato based salsas. Its super hot but addicting served with a side of crispy tortilla chips.
I like the area this place is situated in. There is a lovely walk you can enjoy afterward. There is also the Metro Rail which you can catch.

title: Review: Taizzi Sushi — 2022-04-17
summary: Roll with the tides! Taizzi Sushi in Katy isn't too far from the local mall. Decided to stop by on a whim with a good friend for dinner. I thought the food here was pretty decent. They've got quite a large selection of grub to choose from the menu. I spotted Korean style ramen, bimbimbap, and even p
body: Roll with the tides! Taizzi Sushi in Katy isn't too far from the local mall. Decided to stop by on a whim with a good friend for dinner. I thought the food here was pretty decent. They've got quite a large selection of grub to choose from the menu. I spotted Korean style ramen, bimbimbap, and even poke bowls on the menu. This spot is known for their AYCE selection or just wing it a la carte. Settled in for sushi because that's what this place is known for. First of all, the plaza is tiny and the restaurant is cramped as well. Surprisingly though on a Saturday night, we found decent parking and it wasn't too busy inside the restaurant. Most likely due to the holidays. Service was impeccable, I mean it's a small place so the servers continuously checked up on us. One of them even offered me a fork since I'm not the biggest fan of using chopsticks. Lol. I'd say my favorite item was the baked sushi. I've always been a fan of baked sushi and they've got a decent selection for that kinda grub. The baked salmon sushi that we ordered was tender and quite flavorful. I definitely want to try the baked lobster option next time. Runner up was the peppered tuna sashimi and pink lady sushi. Both of these items had a bite and kick to them. The jasmine tea that was served wasn't that good though; just flat and lukewarm. The interior inside here is dark and cozy, decent for a dinner vibe, in which we settled upon that evening. I don't eat this kinda grub that often but this spot was quite chill. Clean and minimal. They've got a tv inside blasting Korean music that is sure to keep you awake with all the glutinous rice intake. Wouldn't mind revisiting when venturing around the area; especially after shopping and settling in for some cozy starch bombs. That's what sushi is after all, am I right? Lol. Keep it local & prosper! Until next time. :)

title: Review: Tartine Bakery — 2015-05-16
summary: Great selection of desserts. But just okay. I ordered a seasonal berry frangipane tart. The bottom of the dessert was charred and over baked. The black bottom of the tart created a burnt and bitter taste in my mouth. Not so good. The brioche bread pudding had too much of an eggy taste and was not sw
body:
Great selection of desserts. But just okay.
I ordered a seasonal berry frangipane tart. The bottom of the dessert was charred and over baked. The black bottom of the tart created a burnt and bitter taste in my mouth. Not so good. The brioche bread pudding had too much of an eggy taste and was not sweet enough. It was just okay. I did like the generous amount of berries on top. I think i'm more used to sweet and rich bread puddings since I live in the South. The only dessert that I did like was the tres leches cake. I loved the incorporation of the buttery crust against the smoothness of the milky cake. Delish. The cafe au lait was nice as well. I fancied the large bowls the cafe au lait was presented in.
Yes, I am snobby when it comes to desserts. I have a degree in baking and pastry. Tartine was just okay in my experience but I would not mind coming back again and trying something new!

title: Review: Tasti D Lite — 2011-10-24
summary: Superb soft-serve icecream with a variety of flavours to choose from! I love the fact that there is a soft-serve spot here in Houston. As much as I like frozen yogurt, I like soft serve as well, and grew up with it. The tasty flavours are guilt free, and there are several toppings to chose from. I c
body:
Superb soft-serve icecream with a variety of flavours to choose from! I love the fact that there is a soft-serve spot here in Houston. As much as I like frozen yogurt, I like soft serve as well, and grew up with it.
The tasty flavours are guilt free, and there are several toppings to chose from. I came here several months ago with my sisters and cousin. We enjoyed our night here. I chose the mocha almond fudge, it was creamy and sweet. The flavour was light and not too sweet, which I appreciate. There are also ice-cream sandwiches here, which I want to try next time. My sister ordered the green tea flavour, and I was afraid that it wouldn't be good, but it was surprisingly tasty! I am definitely looking forward in coming by again, and choosing a new flavour to indulge myself with!

title: Review: Té House of Tea — 2013-08-24
summary: Te House of Tea has a lovely selection of tea's from around the world I am an avid tea drinker who drinks various types of teas, so I was pleased with the selection offered at Te House. My friend and I both shared the 'metropolis' tea which was quite fragrant and light. The amount of tea in the kett
body:
Te House of Tea has a lovely selection of tea's from around the world
I am an avid tea drinker who drinks various types of teas, so I was pleased with the selection offered at Te House. My friend and I both shared the 'metropolis' tea which was quite fragrant and light. The amount of tea in the kettle was enough for the both of us to share. I also had this vegetarian soup which consisted of sweet potatoes and kale. It was sweet, spicy, and heartwarming. I like their menu selection and how many of the items are vegetarian and vegan friendly. Te House of Tea has live music on the weekend, as well as small performances. I like the atmosphere of this place, it is quaint and cozy. Its a good place to catch up with a friend, enjoy a light meal and douse it down with a comforting cup of tea.

profile: Tea Bar and Organics — Sugar Land
summary: I've been visiting this spot since they've opened yet I have become dissatisfied for good. They are conveniently located in Sugar Land and most places are not open that late, which is why I'd visit every now and then. Their drinks are really watery and are distasteful as well. They don't seem to kno
body: I've been visiting this spot since they've opened yet I have become dissatisfied for good. They are conveniently located in Sugar Land and most places are not open that late, which is why I'd visit every now and then. Their drinks are really watery and are distasteful as well. title: Review: Tea Bar & Organics — Houston — 2015-06-02
summary: So I believe this is the original location of Tea Bar & Organics. The cafe is larger and has far more seating options than the location in Sugar Land. I prefer this location since it's in the heart of Bellaire. There are so many little shops here and I love visiting after a nice outing in the area.
body: So I believe this is the original location of Tea Bar & Organics. The cafe is larger and has far more seating options than the location in Sugar Land. I prefer this location since it's in the heart of Bellaire. There are so many little shops here and I love visiting after a nice outing in the area. I like the vibe and ambiance of this spot. Its always crowded, but you're sure to find a seat. There are many drink, dessert and food options on the menu. Whether its cold or hot outside, I tend to always chose a warm beverage off of the menu. My favorite drink is the hot honey milk tea. I suggest getting this tea with real whole milk and toning down the sugar to 2/3 sweet. The honey milk tea is warm, sweet and satisfying. One of the best that I have had. I love the aroma as well. The milk tea comes in these cute little mugs that are sure to satisfy. What I love most about Tea Bar & Organics is the diversity of the menu. The staff is nice as well and they are prompt with their service. There is something for everyone here.

title: Review: Teacake Factory — 2012-03-19
summary: Its unfortunate to see such terrible reviews for Teacake Factory. I believe most people are not familiar with the concept of teacakes, so they can only make negative remarks about them. These southern style teacakes are moist, flavourful, and tasty. All of the flavours have a distinct taste, and the
body:
Its unfortunate to see such terrible reviews for Teacake Factory. I believe most people are not familiar with the concept of teacakes, so they can only make negative remarks about them.
These southern style teacakes are moist, flavourful, and tasty. All of the flavours have a distinct taste, and they contain fresh ingredients. I don't understand how people can complain about the price of a teacake. It is only two dollars, and it is made from expensive ingredients such as fruits and nuts. I believe these sweet treats are a great price. They are big and it makes it easy to share them with others.
I have also tried their cake, cupcakes, and sandwiches. The cupcakes are too sweet for my liking, but their nutty delight cake is fantastic. When you bite into the cake, you can taste the fresh ingredients, such as the naturally whipped cream. The chicken kebab sandwiches are spicy and exotic. Its a unique twist that tantalizes your taste buds.
Overall, I have had several nice experiences at Teacake factory. The owners are friendly, and they let you sample any of their teacakes. These simple and sweet treats are what keep me coming back for more.

title: Review: Teahouse & Coffee Tapioca Bar — 2010-05-19
summary: I`ve had good experiences at the Tea & Coffee house. The flavours are sweet, and you can actually taste them! The pearls are semi chewy and soft, just the way they should be. This place is pricier than Dulce's, but just over a buck. I also like the atmosphere. The interior is of dark couches, and ta
body:
I`ve had good experiences at the Tea & Coffee house.
The flavours are sweet, and you can actually taste them! The pearls are semi chewy and soft, just the way they should be. This place is pricier than Dulce's, but just over a buck.
I also like the atmosphere. The interior is of dark couches, and tables. It has a different feel than those colourful places. I like it though, change is good. Whenever I come here, it is always nice and quiet. Obviously the blenders will blare a bit. It is a drink shoppe right? They have video games, as well has board games over here. Supposedly they have mic/poetry nights on the weekend. I haven`t checked it out yet, but it sounds nice.
I have tried most of the juice tea blends, as well as the coffee blends. You can actually taste the sweetness and the flavour, opposed to those skimpy shops that put in a little bit of syrup.
A return will definitely be met, due to summer approaching!

title: Review: Tealicious Drinks — 2012-03-19
summary: I'm thankful that a tapioca cafe exists on campus. After long walks in the heat, a nice and cool beverage is always necessary to keep you feeling refreshed. Overall, I have tried most of their tapioca drinks, and have been satisfied. My favourite flavours are the ones that contain juice mixed with t
body:
I'm thankful that a tapioca cafe exists on campus. After long walks in the heat, a nice and cool beverage is always necessary to keep you feeling refreshed. Overall, I have tried most of their tapioca drinks, and have been satisfied. My favourite flavours are the ones that contain juice mixed with tea, such as black tea with mango juice.
As an amateur to banh mi sandwiches, I have found my experience with Tealicious's banh mi to be delightful. My vegetarian sandwich was filled with crispy and fresh vegetables. The tofu had a nice marinade, and the filling consisted of mayo and fried onions as well. The french bread they used for the sandwich was crunchy and chewy. Now that's my type of bread, well toasted!
It's unfortunate that most people have had a bad experience at Tealicious. I can only hope they can improve their service. There have been times when I visited, and they had ran out of tapioca. I can never have my drink without it! I hope this tea cafe can keep their food, drinks, and service consistent in the near future.

title: Review: Teapresso Bar — 2023-01-11
summary: This spot was unusually warm today and the service was mediocre at best; which seems to be the case lately. I've always liked Teapresso and really dig' the location out in the Heights.. (if it's still around). But this location in the heart of Sugar Land could do way better. They were great when the
body: This spot was unusually warm today and the service was mediocre at best; which seems to be the case lately. I've always liked Teapresso and really dig' the location out in the Heights.. (if it's still around). But this location in the heart of Sugar Land could do way better. They were great when they first started out.. which was about 4 years ago. Since then the service has gone downhill and the drinks are steep in price. The young lady at the front never smiles and seems to be irritated at any cost. Nonetheless, some of the drinks are still okay and it's one of the few spots where you can actually get a decent cup of coffee in Sugar Land. Simply because you have an option for choosing organic coffee beans and actual milk in your drinks. I always steer clear from non-dairy creamer and crap coffee. I appreciate the fact that we have a Hawaiian style cafe in town that specializes in tapioca drinks, Kona coffee and a few other items. They have snacks as well as a few hot beverages. Plenty of seating with warm wooden tables and board games as well. It's a decent spot to get some work done or work on anything on your laptop. It can get loud at times because they're obviously making drinks in the corner. All in all, it's a good spot in the area, especially with limited coffee choices (c'mon Sugar Land!). A bit bleak at times.. hoping they can regain their charm. Plus side? Always clean and bright inside.

title: Review: Terry Hershey Park — 2022-05-25
summary: A rather large yet cozy park smacked in the middle of the energy corridor. There are various entrances to reach this park; & yet each entrance happens to guide you through a unique path. I love the large stretched out corridors here. These are tunnels that are full of trees that stretch so far out i
body: A rather large yet cozy park smacked in the middle of the energy corridor. There are various entrances to reach this park; & yet each entrance happens to guide you through a unique path. I love the large stretched out corridors here. These are tunnels that are full of trees that stretch so far out into various pathways and bridges. Great for those that are joggers or bicyclists. I find myself mostly walking here and yet I can't seem to finish the trail. It's easy to get lost here as well. Lol. Unless you spot a map or something. As mentioned, the trails are long and unwinding. I had always known about this park yet its entrances were mysterious, and easily missed. Frequently visiting and being near the beltway, I was able to spot one of the main entrances and that was it. I've been a frequent stroller here for the past 2 years. This park seems to have been here forever; I hope it stays & that it continues to preserve itself within the midst of the concrete jungle. There are vast neighborhoods tucked within the corners of some of the pathways. One of the neighbors decorated a bench and left a mini library outside so walkers can grab books & leave a book as well. It's these little things that are precious & that have made this park ever so charming. I love visiting in Autumn and Spring in particular. Last year I spotted a field of yellow flowers. Just nothing but pure yellow gold all around, as if the sun had dipped its beams into the earth. Support local parks, walk, bike or jog. Or bring your fluffy best friend. Just move a bit and you'll be good! Toodles!

title: Review: Thai Orchid — 2021-11-15
summary: This restaurant really brought in the heat. I honestly thought I could handle any level of spice until I bumped into Thai Orchid on a random Sunday night rendezvous. To be honest, the best food items on the menu are of Laotian and Cambodian influence. The Thai food is not bad but the said cultural i
body: This restaurant really brought in the heat. I honestly thought I could handle any level of spice until I bumped into Thai Orchid on a random Sunday night rendezvous. To be honest, the best food items on the menu are of Laotian and Cambodian influence. The Thai food is not bad but the said cultural influence really takes the cake for the heat. The Som Tum [papaya salad] here is the total winner; super crisp, sour and spicy. I honestly could not handle the heat of this dish. But after a short while I was able to catch my breath and consume most of it. The flavors are super complex and wakes you up silly. Pairing this item with their sweetened cold Thai coffee was the saving grace in regards to catching my breath. I love soup, and their Tom Yum (Thai hot & sour soup) had plenty of depth and zest to it. The soup was brimming with fresh tomatoes, shrimp and mushrooms & topped with cilantro. You can ask for this soup to be vegetarian as well. I really enjoyed their Laad Nah. It is one of my favorite takes on Thai style noodles; brimming with dark gravy, broccoli & onions. Asked for chicken with this dish and it accompanied the gravy and veggies quite well. This particular dish is not spicy & is more on the savory and sweet side; which made it pair well with the other items. The menu at Thai Orchid is quite large and extensive. I would love to try other items off of their menu next time. A bit far off from my usual travels though. If you're in the Northern parts of Houston, & passing through Spring, I recommend visiting this spot. Owners are friendly, decor is okay, but the grub is fresh. & As always, it's great to support local biz.

title: Review: Thai Siam — 2010-05-28

body:
Thai Siam is a cozy and small restaurant.
The decoration inside is of a traditional and cultural feel. I love places that give off that vibe.
I have enjoyed the Pad Kee Mao and Pad Thai. Both dishes are served with thin rice noodles and flavourful meats and vegetables.
Tom Kha Gai Soup is a bit sour to my taste. I know that lemon grass and lime juice are used, but it was a bit too over powering. The soup is served in an interesting bowl that makes it hard to take out the contents. I do like how they thought of using a traditional soup bowl, but it is not practical.
For appetizer's, I recommend Sate and Tod Mun Pla (fish cakes). The Sate is served with a beautiful peanut sauce which is highly addictive. (I LOVE peanut butter!) The Tod Mun Pla is basically spicy fried minced fish cakes. It is served with a spicy red pepper cucumber relish. Delicious!
The curries here are warm, fragrant, and fill up your bellie! I have been pleased with both the Green Curry, and Massamun Curry. They are rich and spicy, served up with a side of steaming jasmine rice.
For a refreshing drink, sip on some Thai Iced Tea. Although I would not recommend ordering it with tapioca. The pearls are overly cooked. My drink was tasty, minus the pearls which were too soft.
Overall, I always enjoy my experience at this quiet neighborhood restaurant. The waitresses are kind and graceful as well. Also, they always have Food Network playing on their television! Yay, my favourite channel. ;)

title: Review: The Oceanaire Seafood Room — 2023-09-12
summary: 3 stars experience during Houston Restaurant Weeks. Boy, were we all excited to dine in at this restaurant. It is a Houston classic! From the submarine looking terrain, to the large windows at the corner facing one of the busiest streets in Houston. It's the Galleria after all, and its one of the mo
body:
3 stars experience during Houston Restaurant Weeks.
Boy, were we all excited to dine in at this restaurant. It is a Houston classic!
From the submarine looking terrain, to the large windows at the corner facing one of the busiest streets in Houston. It's the Galleria after all, and its one of the most popular spots to visit. This restaurant has been around for over 20 years, and for some of us, it was our very first time.
I do believe they could have had better choices in regards to their food menu with HRW. This is all in regards to food allergies, mind you. So thats something we take seriously. But we came on a mission! To dine in on HRW style menu which benefits the local Houston Food banks.
Their regular menu looks great and appealing. We may revisit and try items from their everyday menu. We did try their sushi and we loved it. The sushi was fresh and flavorful. It retained its shape well and came with a burst of flavor. My second favorite was the smoked salmon. It was chunky, held its shape and it had a great umami yet mellow flavor as well. Paired well with the bold marinated onions, capers, relish and crispy crackers.
I did like the shrimp fried rice, it was flavorful and well seasoned - however it was quite luke-warm by the time it reached our table. Reason being? They forgot to deliver our order to the table. We waited for ages after being served appetizers. So much time passed by that I had to flag down a waiter from far away, just to get his notice and ask him what happened to our food?
He quickly went in, back of the house and grabbed our meals. So basically our meals were sitting BOH, chillin and getting cold. No apologies or "I'm sorry for the delay in your food". Instead he mentioned, "Oh, we're packed and having a busy day here". Definitely didn't seem like it, with most of the room being empty. Just one day before, my entire office dined in here for HRW. What must have happened then? Not enough employees to accommodate diners needs. Lack of customer service was the down fall of our experience dining here at the Oceanaire.
Dessert was good. It was ordered from their regular menu as its not provided with HRW. We opted for the key lime pie and it was definitely one of the better ones we've all had. Super tart, sweet and refreshing. Perfect on the palate after consuming mellow oceanic foods.
Again, we all enjoyed our food. Totally look forward to revisiting and trying items from their regular menu. This is a nice spot to bring out of town guests. They have many non-seafood items as well for those that aren't much into seafood. We're just hoping for warmer and keen attentive service next time around for such a posh and elaborate spot such as this.
Until next time!

Other than that, the cupcake was of standard size, and of average quality. My little cousin ate a red velvet cupcake, and thought it was decent. I think i'll stick to the macaroons offered at TSB, there are many flavours and colours to choose from. They would also make as good gifts and party favors if hosting an event. Give 'em a try!

body:
Soo, the waffle bus has finally made its appearance to the University of Houston! Its nice to know that these guys will be serving up some mean waffles during this hot and weary semester!
I had the chance of trying a few items from the waffle bus these last two days. There was a moderate line of people waiting and it was darn hot outside. Regardless, that did not stop me in wanting to try a waffle from this popular food truck. My first pick was the nutella and banana waffle. This gorgeous waffle sandwich was slathered with nutella and topped with sliced bananas. A thin amount of sweet cream was then laced on top of the fruit. The sandwich itself was quite huge and filling. My inner sweet tooth was well satisfied with this decadent treat. The next day I tried the smoked salmon waffle sandwich. The item itself sounded unique, and I was not afraid of trying it. To my disappointment, the meal itself was not anything spectacular. In fact, I did not like the combination of flavours in the waffle sandwich. I could not finish the rest, and decided to only stick to sweet and traditional waffles from then on. The concept of a smoked salmon waffle is unique, but its definitely a taste that is acquired.
Overall, the waffle bus has an amazing idea, and I can only hope the best of luck for these young guys. I will definitely stick to the sweeter side of waffles that are doused in chocolate and fruits! I think Ive found a winner here!

body:
"Aw, what a cute little patisserie!"
Those were the words that came out of my mouth as I found this little gem, tucked in Uptown Park. It was also my first visit to the park. Small, pretty, with little shops here and there.
I have only came in here on a few visits to pick up sweets. Almond croissant is the first word muttered out of my mouth, as I explain to the cashier on what to fill my bag with. Then comes scones, brownie, and cranberry bar.
The almond croissant is generously loaded with almonds, and marzipan. It is huge, and can feed up to three people. Thats if you don`t mind sharing! ;)
The Swiss brownies have the perfect amount of semi sweet cocoa, and have a chewy moist taste. They are definitely the gourmet fix for brownies!
Scones are heavy, and crumble in your mouth. Just the way they should be. It is dotted with crispy cinnamon sugar.
Cranberry bars are refreshingly zesty! A nice blend of sweetness with just the right amount of tartness. The lemon gives it a clean taste.
Oh yes... also petit fours! How can I forget to mention them. They are mini little cakes that are wrapped around a green coloured marzipan layer. The inside of the cake is layered with a soft filling of raspberry. Quite wonderful!
I want to try out Thierry's for lunch one day. Not sure if its any good? I may give it a try, seeing how I have been pleased with their treats.

summary: Such a great little gem of a coffee shoppe tucked in a quiet corner within the suburbs of Katy, TX. body:
Such a great little gem of a coffee shoppe tucked in a quiet corner within the suburbs of Katy, TX.
Tim Horton's is originally from Canada.. & is all the rage up in the northern hemisphere... & I can totally see why! It is considered Canada's favorite coffee on the run. This spot specializes in both hot and cold coffee drinks, as well as donuts, pastries and a few savory items. Had heard about Tim Hortons back in the day.. just hadn't ventured out to Canada in awhile. I am glad we have a location here in TX, which is soon to spread out within neighboring cities. Hot coffee was great.. nice and simple. Drip coffee paired with a donut? Keeping it old school. I didn't care for any cold bevvie that day.. but my friends cold brew vanilla drink looked good. Plenty of holiday flavors this time of the year as well. They have a variety of donuts to choose from.. my favorite being the cake donut. Tender and sprinkled a bit with nutmeg. Dunk it into hot coffee.. bliss. The other donuts were on the drier side & didn't taste fresh. That's too bad because this spot specializes in their sweet treats. Also tried their avocado toast which was just okay. I'm glad they have a bit of savory items to balance with all the sweetness. Interior is quite small.. but cozy. Decor is quite heartwarming and very Canadian. Service was okay.. could be better. Their drive thru seemed chaotic and I totally recommend visiting the interior of the cafe. All in all, a great spot to set up shoppe. I'll definitely revisit in the near future. Here's hoping we can get more Hortons on the way.. because "Horton hears a who! & A why not?!" Lol. Totally a Dr Seuss reference.. if you know, you know. Cheers and happy coffee drinking during the coziest month of the year!

title: Review: Tønsberg Brygge — 2022-02-10
summary: Tønsberg is quite a beautiful little town. Historical and considered to be the oldest town in Norway. It became an important trading center and was founded by Vikings in the 9th century. In fact, Tonsberg Old Cemetery contains 22 war graves, of the First World War, 14 of them unidentified by name, b
body: Tønsberg is quite a beautiful little town. Historical and considered to be the oldest town in Norway. It became an important trading center and was founded by Vikings in the 9th century. In fact, Tonsberg Old Cemetery contains 22 war graves, of the First World War, 14 of them unidentified by name, but all naval casualties from the Battle of Jutland in 1916. This town is charming with it's cobblestone streets, in particular near their shopping district. I used to live in this town back in 2017, for about half of the year. Visiting the brygge, (pier) was always such a nice and tranquil escape. Their are plenty of restaurants outlined near the brygge. Some of the restaurants were diverse within their culinary range and the food wasn't too bad. I did not have the best culinary experience in Norway, but they did have a decent Indian restaurant by the pier. Local caught seafood was fresh and of good quality. They typically displayed that sort of fare during the farmers market. The pier would be freezing towards the autumn and winter seasons. The townsfolk launch their old historical boats during the holiday season and it is a sight to see. Many of the cafes, coffee shops and restaurants would close by 8-9 pm. Grocery stores and many shoppes were closed on Sundays. As an American, it was a bit of a culture shock. But the major differences I experienced in this town drove me towards introspection and deep growth. The glassy icey water reminded of a mirror upon self reflection. I may have been on the outside looking in, but it was a beautiful ponderous ride. I recommend visiting the pier and just overall experiencing this quiet, elegant town.

body: Nice warehouse converted into a minimal industrial like dessert cafe. I came here not too long ago with my good friend. It was about 9ish pm yet I felt safe once I got inside Tout Suit. The cafe is situated in a completely random spot near downtown. A bit far from where I live yet i'd been wanting to check out this place for a while. Tout Suite certainly has lived up to the rave reviews. Upon entering, I noticed the ambiance of the place. It was quite lively during that time of night. There were many types of people here - youngsters and oldies. The amount of selections here is truly what gives this place high marks from me. Most other 'dessert cafes' tend to run out of selection once evening/nightfall hits. Yet Tout Suite was brimming with cupcakes, cookies, danishes, croissants and more. They have a variety of colorful macaroons as well. I'm not much of a fan of macaroons, so I did not get any for myself. I opted for the cream cheese danish and was delightfully surprised it was national cupcake day, in which they gave me and my friend a mini cupcake. How sweet! Speaking of sweet, I noticed right away that these were the same folks as SWEET from CityCentre. I had not known this before, so that was a sweet surprise. (No pun intended, haha). I also ordered their cafe latte, which was creamy and smooth. I love the beans they use.. such quality coffee. Overall, my friend and I enjoyed our desserts and had a great experience at Tout Suite. I also appreciate the fact that they close late! It seems as if their are such few cafes that close as late as Tout Suite and without having that trendy "bar/alcohol" environment. I don't like such places with the bar atmosphere as the environment tends to get rowdy and loud. We didn't feel pressured to leave as soon as we got there. This place also carries fresh fruit juices and savory foods as well. I might drop by in the afternoon one day to try out their savory menu. All in all, a lovely spot to visit with friends and a great place to bring out of town folks as well.

body: The Turkish Cultural Center is such a warm and welcoming spot. They often host all kinds of events here, such as community or multi-cultural events. I have been visiting the "Turquoise/ Raindrop Center" for over a decade plus. This is a fun gathering spot for all, no matter what age bracket you fall under. The building itself is quite unique and the marble for it was imported from Turkey. They have a small café inside the cultural center, as well as a prayer room. The folks that run this place, such as the staff, are all incredibly warm and friendly. This is a wonderful spot to visit, it will surely make you feel like you're out of country, or completely elsewhere. It gives me the travel bug to visit Turkiye, but it also gives me an appreciation of living in such a diverse city such as Houston. Check-out this cultural center; it is warm and welcoming to all, no matter your origin or background. You can even subscribe to their email list in order to ensure that you don't miss out on any events! A cool home away from home spot, they even have a park in the backyard for children. See it for yourself!

body: I've been coming here for a couple of years now. The yogurt cafe is always clean and organized. There's never any sticky yogurt on the floor nor clinging to the pumps. I love the colorful interior and chairs as well. There is one complaint though - the lack of flavors. Having come here for a few years, the flavors start to get repetitive. It would be nice if they can change up their flavors from time to time. The bright side is that my favourite flavours such as coconut and lychee are always present. A better selection of fresh fruit would give this place some diversity as well. I stay away from putting candies in my yogurt as it gets too sweet. All in all, Frutti Tutti is in a convenient location. Nice way to drop by every once in awhile when a yogurt craving hits.

body: Yum! Try the Vada Pav here. It is soo good! I was craving a spicy and crispy potato sandwich and that is what I got here. Love those carb on carbs + plus vegetarian food! I had never tried a vada pav before, yet I knew how it would taste. We make something similar at home anyway. The crispy potato sandwich was fresh and served on warm rolls. The bread was soft and tender and the potato sliders were piping hot. The sliders are spicy and bursting with flavor. So if you're not into spicy food, I would suggest you not order it. We came here on Christmas eve and got to try a few samples that the generous owner left on this large table for all customers. The chaat is spicy and so are the puff pastries. So if you're not into spicy food, I would at least ask for a sample. Because chances are, you might not be able to handle hot Indian style street food + snacks. Anyway, I definitely recommend this place. They have different kinds of foods, such as rice dishes, and wraps as well. They also have cakes, cookies, coffee and chai! Check out this bakery cafe if youre curious in trying something new and full of flavour. :) I'm looking forward to coming back soon.

title: Review: Van Leeuwen Ice Cream — 2022-04-28
summary: Creamy and dreamy, refreshing ice-cream. I visited exactly a month ago with a good friend of mine. I had never tried Van Leeuwen although I spotted it a few times out in New York. That's where VL is originally from and it's great to have a spot here down in the H. This is not their first location bu
body:
Creamy and dreamy, refreshing ice-cream.
I visited exactly a month ago with a good friend of mine. I had never tried Van Leeuwen although I spotted it a few times out in New York. That's where VL is originally from and it's great to have a spot here down in the H. This is not their first location but it's definitely a cozy spot to open up shoppe. We have plenty of ice-cream spots in the area but us gourmand Houstonians will happily welcome any new kid on the block. All prestigious and cute, we visited during their grand opening. Truly was a great experience, folks were friendly and fast, whipping up batches and scooping em up in cones or cups. I was soo excited to try their Royal Wedding cake flavor and it was darn good! Might not be on the menu for too long as it's a seasonal flavor. Royal Wedding cake ice cream// "Floral, sweet cream cheese ice cream. Chunks of lemon sponge cake layered with elderflower frosting." Another flavor that's a total classic is their honeycomb ice-cream. It paired perfectly well with their crispy and fresh waffle cone.
I was delighted. The flavor I got was regal, classy and sweet. Just the way I like things. I'm a fan of elderflower notes and the lemon definitely spritzied up the flavor, which goes so well with said notes. This spot has always been known for their vegan flavors. But all those that love moo milk can rejoice, because they have classic dairy flavors as well. I thought VL would outdo itself in a not good way, but it was great and I'm happy to welcome this spot in the new Montrose Collective Plaza. Toodle-oo! You'll be a sweet spot to savour during these warmer months that are coming up ahead. Keep calm, chill out, and eat some ice-cream!

title: Review: Viva Juice Coffee & Tea — 2015-11-01
summary: I came into Viva Juice Coffee and Tea after my dentist appointment. Had some time to pass before heading to work so I dropped into this little cafe. body: I came into Viva Juice Coffee and Tea after my dentist appointment. Had some time to pass before heading to work so I dropped into this little cafe. I was greeted kindly by Thanh and he was quite patient with me as I decided on my order. I finally opted for the coffee milk tea with tapioca. Thought it would be a good choice to get in slight caffeine before work. They have many beverage flavors here as most tapioca cafes would offer. I was quite happy with my order as I sat down and drank my cold and creamy milk tea. The owners were kind enough to use milk in my coffee rather than non dairy creamer. Pretty good tapioca. The pearls were sweet in flavor and had a nice chewy yet firm bite. Just the right consistency! I am quite picky with tapioca tea's but they deliver a great product and i'll definitely be back when i'm in the area.

title: Review: Voodoo Doughnut — Downtown Houston — 2017-12-26
summary: This doughnut shop tucked on east 6th street is open 24 hours 7 days of the week! When you have a hankering for doughnuts.. this place will always be there for you. That's definitely magical for a shop called Voodoo Doughnuts. I'm glad that we have one here in Texas.. the far and few locations are t
body: This doughnut shop tucked on east 6th street is open 24 hours 7 days of the week! When you have a hankering for doughnuts.. this place will always be there for you. That's definitely magical for a shop called Voodoo Doughnuts. I'm glad that we have one here in Texas.. the far and few locations are tucked out in the West Coast. So.. this place did live up to its hype. Came here at night and this place was happening. That's normally not the vibe at doughnut shops. My sister and I dived in and grabbed a handful of different doughnuts. We came, saw, conquered and ate.. almost all of them. I recommend the apple fritter, any of the cake donuts, and the voodoo looking donut, which had a chocolate glaze to it. They were all scrumptious, fresh and fluffy. None of the doughnuts were crazy sweet.. if anything.. they were addicting. The doughnuts were packed in their large iconic pink shaped box. Sat inside and enjoyed them. Quite a large crowd on a weekend night. The decor inside is funky, colorful and lively. Staff was friendly as well. If you're strolling through 6th street.. I definitely recommend dropping by. Grab some doughnuts and enjoy in good company. Parking for us wasn't a problem as we parked in the garage and wanted to have a nice walk. Trust me.. you'll need that walk after pecking on a few doughnuts. Until next time Voodoo.. you're spooky good.

body: Yum! Authentic Belgian liege waffles in the Vegas Strip. Would have never known to have found this gem of a place while visiting the city. This little outdoor food stall offers some great and authentic Belgian style waffles. I was in the mood for a simple waffle with no toppings or anything. Didn't want the extra sugar and the prices were quite steep as it is. The plain Belgian waffle was so delicious, buttery and crispy! The pearl sugar in each bite brought a caramelized taste. Smelled like a sweet and simple crepe. I had always wanted to try this type of waffle and I finally got to. If you're looking for a unique sweet treat, then I urge you to visit this little stall. It certainly aroused my attention after mostly observing cookie cutter restaurants and places to eat in the strip. Oh and it's a sweet treat that is quite big so it's easy to share with others.

body: Not that good... The waffle was warm but dry in taste and texture.. because of this.. it got stuck on the paper boat container that it came in. I have had better Belgian style waffles throughout my travels and this certainly wasn't it. Flavorwise it wasn't bad and the aroma was buttery and lightly sweet, but overall it was just okay in execution. Chocolate sauce and fruit were added on top. Initially I wanted a plain butter waffle but decided to add toppings to it as well. In regard to pricing, it gets expensive with the adding and layering of toppings. They have a decent hot beverage menu so I opted for their hot chocolate. Not bad, but just okay, like the waffle. Gatlinburg is quite a touristy area so the service was appreciated. This is a unique choice of dessert for that part of town. It was appreciated among the cafes that had pancakes and coffee, but was just hoping for a better flavor. Something with more butter, flavor, and tenderness to the waffle. At least you can walk around town with this portable dessert while sightseeing in Gatlinburg. Try it for yourself.

He loved the bright claw machines which have been all the rage this summer season. Hello 90's vibrancy and excitement. No Labubu for us, we're good. We were happy to hangout with Pekkle the duck instead... Sanrio for life. Again..cue the 90s vibes. Thank you for joining in on the adventure this week.... Both Mark and I are 16 years Yelp Elite... And it's always fun to chat about the city and the latest scoop of what goes on in town.
Looking forward to revisiting WoW - West on West, when more shops open and pop up!

title: Review: Whole Foods Market — 2010-05-07
summary: I love Whole Foods! Thankful to have a great selection in Sugar Land. I frequent this market often. I have never been disappointed. It is an epicureans dream! body:
I love Whole Foods! Thankful to have a great selection in Sugar Land. I frequent this market often. I have never been disappointed. It is an epicureans dream! They have all sorts of foods that I can not find anywhere else. I cook/bake often, and usually need rare and unique items. This is the place for your one stop food ~ list journey. I also love the sample selections they have during the weekend. Stop by on those days, and you can munch away on freebies. They also have cooking classes on the weekends time to time. Just ask the front for more information. I have been to a raw food class, and I thought it was interesting. They have beautifully packaged items, and desserts that can make as wonderful gift's. I usually come in here for lunch and grab some hot & steaming soup! Mm, all the flavours are fantastic. I also love their black bean enchilada's. The food is always piping hot and fresh.
I can get lost here and never want to leave. Thank you for being my neighbour, Whole Foods.

body: The fresh date shake here was marvelous.. thick in viscosity, creamy and out of this world. The aroma reminded me of brown sugar and the flavor was warm, even though it was a cold and creamy milkshake. They use fresh dates that are commonly grown near and around the palm springs area. We didn't get to venture too deep within Palm Springs, but this was the closest market to us when we were venturing out of Joshua Tree. Folks were friendly and efficient with their service. We opted for the vanilla ice cream date shake, which is the original flavor here. The dates just melt in your mouth and are totally otherworldly, along with the fresh packaged dates that you can purchase here. They make for a great gift as well, and there are plenty of different flavors - my favorite being the dates rolled in dessicated coconut. All in all, this is a pretty neat spot. I'd love to revisit and try their savory foods and other items as well. Geographically, it's super cool to be surrounded by windmills nearby, literally and figuratively. When around and passing through the Yucca Valley, you can count on Windmill Market & Produce for a great beverage and perhaps a snack or two while cruising through your road trip. :) Until next time!

title: Review: World Market — 2020-07-21
summary: It is wonderful to explore this culturally diverse store during limited moments of travelling. Anything cultural and world related excites the heck out of me. Thank y'all for recently opening this store during such obscure times like this. World Market cost plus has always been a favorite store of m
body: It is wonderful to explore this culturally diverse store during limited moments of travelling. Anything cultural and world related excites the heck out of me. Thank y'all for recently opening this store during such obscure times like this. World Market cost plus has always been a favorite store of mine. We had a location in Sugar Land a solid decade ago. It is where I would pick-up my favorite culinary related products. All things spices and dried goods. That location unfortunately closed down a long time ago. Fast forward in this present moment and we now have a location in Stafford. Just a skip away from Sugar Land. This location is not as large as the one near Galleria Post oak. Or it at least doesn't seem to carry as many items. I mean that location in Houston has been around for ages anyway. I am sure this location will surely catch up and given these obscure times. Still, with so much to see here, it makes fun for wandering around and picking up a few things. I have picked up candles, spices, halal gummy candies and chocolate to name a few. My favorite is the marzipan chocolate from Germany. I was able to spot a nice selection of various British and international teas. They have a great selection of mugs, bowls and beautiful pottery stuff. If you're into cultural stuff as I am.. you'll dig this store. It's my home away from home. Good service and warm ambiance. When the travel bug bites.. I make my way to World Market cost plus. Until next time. Adeus!

summary: Solid location of YogurtLand, although located in the mall, this spot offers plenty of flavors that are delectable with fresh toppings. Manager was kind and passionate. body: Solid location of YogurtLand, although located in the mall, this spot offers plenty of flavors that are delectable with fresh toppings. Manager was kind and passionate. Explained they only used fresh fruit and never any frozen fruit. The strawberries and blueberries that I added to my yogurt had a good bite and were vivid in color. I tried the pumpkin spice cold brew coffee and milk tea yogurt flavors today. They were great. I love that YogurtLand often introduces new flavors for each season. A classic favorite is the dutch chocolate and pistachio flavors. Crisp and creamy, you can never go wrong with frozen yogurt. I actually think it's best that they halted the usage of sample cups. That was becoming an unsanitary mess. This location is clean and so are the yogurt machines. They no longer have their water fountain by the front side of the store. I believe taking sanitary and precaution measures is best at this time and this location does that best. YogurtLand is a sweet spot to drop by, whilst grabbing some cuppa' yogurt and then walking around the mall. I'll definitely be back to visit and try new flavors. Until next time!

summary: This place serves up a plethora of frozen yogurt. You cant go wrong with Yogurtland, there's so many flavours to chose from. Its definitely a place for those who crave a nice frozen treat. My taste-buds were craving non-tart flavours, so I opted for the dutch chocolate, as well as the coconut yogurt
body:
This place serves up a plethora of frozen yogurt. You cant go wrong with Yogurtland, there's so many flavours to chose from. Its definitely a place for those who crave a nice frozen treat.
My taste-buds were craving non-tart flavours, so I opted for the dutch chocolate, as well as the coconut yogurt. Both flavours were good on their own, and when mixed together, they tasted even better. I felt as if I was eating a german chocolate cake; except in yogurt form. How guilt free is that? I opted for cookie dough bites in my yogurt as well, which gave the flavours a toothier bite. I know that Yogurtland is popular in California, so its nice to know that there are a few locations here in Houston. I will definitely come back again to try their other seasonal flavours.
